### [173] [A new approach for the determination of through-thickness and free-edge stresses in composite laminates based on structural elements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27559)
*Xiaopeng Ai,Christos Kassapoglou,Boyang Chen*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Kirchhoff-Love假设的多层复合结构单元中捕捉自由边缘效应的方法，通过采用结构内聚单元并利用从层合板富树脂层推导的精确罚刚度来恢复层间面外应力分量，从而准确预测复合材料层合板的损伤萌生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Kirchhoff-Love假设的薄壳单元仅考虑三个面内应力分量（两个面内正应力和一个面内剪应力），缺乏常规三维损伤准则所需的面外应力分量，导致复合材料层合板的损伤萌生无法被准确预测。

Method: 提出一种适用于任意复合材料铺层的多层结构单元方法：(1) 采用结构内聚单元对复合材料层合板进行建模；(2) 利用从层合板树脂富集层推导的精确罚刚度；(3) 通过精确表征界面力学响应，恢复面外应力分量。

Result: 该方法能够捕捉自由边缘效应，并通过恢复面外应力分量实现复合材料层合板损伤萌生的准确预测。

Conclusion: 所提出的罚刚度法有效弥补了Kirchhoff-Love壳理论在面外应力分量方面的缺陷，为基于结构单元的复合材料层合板损伤预测提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Thin shell elements based on the Kirchhoff-Love hypothesis account for only three stress components: the in-plane normal stresses and the in-plane shear stress. The out-of-plane stress components required by conventional three-dimensional damage criteria are unavailable. As a result, damage initiation in composite laminates cannot be accurately predicted. This paper presents a method for capturing free edge effects in multilayer structural elements with arbitrary composite layups based on the Kirchhoff-Love hypothesis.The proposed formulation employs structural cohesive elements to model composite laminates and uses an accurate penalty stiffness derived from the laminate's resin-rich layers. By accurately characterizing the interfacial mechanical response, out-of-plane stress components can be recovered.

</details>


### [174] [Data-free neural PDE solvers based on Graph Neural Networks and weak forms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27901)
*Mikel M. Iparraguirre,Iciar Alfaro,David Gonzalez,Elias Cueto*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息的数据自由神经网络求解器，采用图神经网络架构和消息传递机制，利用有限元形函数梯度的弱形式而非自动微分来计算残差，实现PDE求解，能泛化到未见载荷和几何，收敛误差小于1%，并可用残差作为推理误差指标进行测试阶段细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的物理信息神经网络（PINN）面临训练需要大量高保真合成数据、自动微分计算代价高昂、几何泛化能力不足等困难。作者旨在提出一种无需训练数据、利用几何机器学习（图神经网络）提供几何偏置的方法来克服这些挑战。

Method: 采用基于图神经网络（GNN）的消息传递架构，利用PDE的弱形式，使用有限元形函数梯度（多项式）而非自动微分算子来计算网络预测位移的方程残差。残差本身可用作推理阶段的误差指示器，若未达到用户预设的残差容差，可在测试阶段执行细化（refinement）。

Result: 该方法能泛化到未见过的载荷工况和几何，收敛误差（残差）小于1%，可扩展至大规模模型和任意几何形状。示例展示了该方法在物理一致性和推理保证方面的性能。

Conclusion: 该方法避免了获取、整理和存储高保真合成数据的高昂成本，并将数据自由的弱形式求解方案与具备几何偏置的图神经网络技术首次结合，有效克服了PINN的已知困难，为PDE数值求解提供了一种物理一致、可扩展且可量化的新途径。

Abstract: We present a physics-informed, data-free neural solver for partial differential equations, built on a graph neural network architecture that utilises message passing. By relying on the weak form of the problem, we use gradients of finite-element shape functions (which are therefore polynomials) rather than automatic differentiation operators to compute the residuals of the equation from the displacements predicted by the network itself. Our approach generalises to previously unseen load cases and geometries, achieving easily convergence errors in the residuals of less than 1% and being capable of scaling up to models of considerable size and arbitrary geometries.
  To ensure compliance with the laws of physics and provide guarantees regarding the inference, it is possible to use the residual itself as an error indicator for the inference, and thus perform a refinement at the testing stage if the residual tolerance set in advance by the user is not met. Examples are provided to demonstrate the performance of the proposed method. This results in a method that avoids the costly process of obtaining, curating and storing high-fidelity synthetic data for training the neural network. Whilst this is not unique to our method, it is the first time it has been combined with a geometric machine learning technique capable of providing the necessary geometric bias to overcome the well-known difficulties of physics-informed neural networks.

</details>


### [175] [Can Large Language Models Execute Parent Orders?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28410)
*Zane Shen,Xinli Xu,Guangyi Zhang,Jialong Chen,Jinsong Zhou,Cong Chen,Guibao Shen,Dongyu Yan,Luozhou Wang,Zhen Yang*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地研究了大语言模型（LLMs）在父订单执行中的应用，提出PACE（Plan-Ahead Controlled Execution）分层框架，将父订单执行分解为长期规划和短期执行，无需显式市场假设或任务特定训练。在深交所Level-1数据上，PACE超越TWAP、Almgren-Chriss及基于学习的基线方法，超过最强基线0.65bps。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法交易中的父订单执行是核心问题，目标是将大订单拆分为小订单以降低执行成本。现有方法要么依赖预先设定的市场假设（在实际中可能不成立），要么需要任务特定训练而限制了对新环境的适应性。作者希望克服这些局限，探索LLM在这一问题上的应用潜力。

Method: 提出PACE（Plan-Ahead Controlled Execution）分层框架，将父订单执行分解为长时域规划（long-horizon planning）和短时域执行（short-horizon execution）两个层次，既不需要显式的市场假设，也不需要任务特定的训练。

Result: 在深圳证券交易所Level-1数据上的实验表明，PACE在性能上优于TWAP、Almgren-Chriss以及基于学习的基线方法，超过最强基线0.65个基点（bps）。行为分析进一步揭示LLM的决策方式与人类投资者不同：更高的模型置信度预示着更好的表现而非更差的回报，且模型倾向于更早交易而非拖延到截止时间。

Conclusion: LLM在父订单执行中可以有效补充人类交易者的决策，其表现优于传统方法和学习型基线。行为分析显示LLM与人类投资者的决策模式存在显著差异，这些发现表明LLM有望在算法交易的执行决策中发挥互补作用。

Abstract: Parent-order execution is a core problem in algorithmic trading, where the goal is to split a large order into smaller orders while reducing execution costs. Existing approaches either rely on pre-specified market assumptions that may not hold in practice, or require task-specific training that limits adaptability to new settings. To overcome these limitations, we present the first systematic study of large language models (LLMs) for parent-order execution. This extends the use of LLMs in finance from what to trade to how to execute. We propose PACE (Plan-Ahead Controlled Execution), a hierarchical framework that decomposes parent-order execution into long-horizon planning and short-horizon execution, requiring neither explicit market assumptions nor task-specific training. Experiments on Shenzhen Stock Exchange Level-1 data show that PACE outperforms TWAP, Almgren-Chriss, and learning-based baselines, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.65 bps. Behavioral analysis reveals that LLMs make execution decisions differently from human investors: higher model confidence predicts better performance rather than worse returns, and the model trades earlier rather than procrastinating toward the deadline. These findings suggest that LLMs can complement human traders in execution decisions.

</details>


### [176] [CoLAS: Multimodal Corroboration of Latent Asset Signals for Financial Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28446)
*Yanzheng Jin,Pengyang Shao,Xiaohao Liu,Xi Ai,Fei Shen,Kenji Kawaguchi*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出CoLAS框架，将多模态佐证（multimodal corroboration）操作化为可训练的任务条件表示，用于金融交易预测。通过软最大化频谱目标强化模态表示的共享主导成分，利用带符号的模态贡献构建非抵消性佐证信号，并引入鲁棒性感知一致性目标应对模态损坏或缺失。在股票和加密货币数据集上，CoLAS在年化收益率和夏普比率方面均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融多模态方法仅将不同模态（价格序列、新闻、投资者情绪）简单组合以利用互补性，将各模态视为同等价值，忽略了模态间是否为同一交易信号提供相互支持性证据。由于单一金融观点噪声大且信息弱，跨异构视图持续出现的支持可能比仅出现在单一视图中的证据更稳定、更具任务相关性。

Method: CoLAS框架的核心包括：1）将各模态表示组织成逐实例矩阵；2）利用基于softmax的频谱目标强化矩阵的支配性共享成分；3）通过带符号模态贡献判断该成分是否提供非抵消性支持，从而构建佐证信号；4）引入鲁棒性感知一致性目标，在模态损坏或缺失时保持佐证信号的一致性。

Result: 在股票和加密货币数据集上的广泛实验表明，CoLAS在年化收益率和夏普比率两个关键金融指标上均取得了一致的改进，优于现有方法。

Conclusion: CoLAS验证了多模态佐证这一任务条件化、非抵消性支持属性在金融交易中的价值，为多模态金融信号提取提供了新的思路，即不仅关注模态间的互补性，更关注跨模态的一致性与相互印证。

Abstract: Financial trading relies on extracting reliable signals from heterogeneous market modalities such as price series, breaking news, and investor sentiment. Existing multimodal methods primarily combine heterogeneous modalities to exploit complementarity, treating each modality as equally valuable while overlooking whether different modalities provide mutually supportive evidence for the same trading signal. However, this task-conditioned and non-canceling support, termed multimodal corroboration, is particularly valuable, especially for financial trading. Because individual financial views are noisy and weakly informative, support that persists across heterogeneous views may provide a more stable task-relevant signal than evidence appearing in only one view. To exploit this property, we propose CoLAS (multimodal Corroboration of Latent Asset Signals), a framework that operationalizes multimodal corroboration as a trainable task-conditioned representation for trading prediction. The modality representations are organized into a per-instance matrix, where a softmax-based spectral objective strengthens its dominant shared component. Signed modality contributions then determine whether this component provides non-canceling support and construct the resulting corroborated signal. A coupled robustness-aware consistency objective further preserves the resulting corroborated signal when a modality is corrupted or missing. Extensive experiments on stock and cryptocurrency datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed CoLAS, yielding consistent improvements in both annualized return and Sharpe ratio over existing methods.

</details>


### [177] [Topology optimization of conduction-radiation problems based on a ray-tracing approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28534)
*Shun Noguchi,Naoyuki Ishida,Jike Han,Kazuhiro Izui,Shinji Nishiwaki*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 提出一种基于密度的拓扑优化方法，用于处理传导-辐射耦合传热问题，通过区域法结合光线追踪进行多向相互辐射分析，并在优化过程中将中间密度视为参与介质来实现物理一致的热辐射评估，通过伴随法推导解析灵敏度，数值算例展示了辐射散热器和辐射屏蔽的最优设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间系统中电子设备的散热依赖辐射传热，需要高效的辐射冷却装置设计进行拓扑优化。现有方法对辐射传热有简化处理，难以完全考虑多向相互辐射效应，亟需一种能够完整考虑该效应的优化方法。

Method: 将基于区域法并结合光线追踪的辐射传热分析集成到有限元热传导分析中；优化过程中将中间材料密度视为参与介质，从而对隐式表示的结构边界进行物理一致的热辐射评估；采用伴随法推导解析设计灵敏度，并与有限差分法数值灵敏度进行验证对比。

Result: 通过数值算例展示了辐射散热器和辐射屏蔽的优化设计。散热器算例阐明了传导与辐射之间的平衡如何主导最终设计形态；辐射屏蔽算例生成了多层隔热结构，这是传统方法无法获得的。

Conclusion: 该方法成功解决了拓扑优化中难以全面考虑多向相互辐射的难题，实现了对传导-辐射耦合传热问题的物理一致优化，可生成传统方法无法得到的多层辐射屏蔽结构，为空间系统辐射冷却装置设计提供了新的工具。

Abstract: Thermal management is essential in space systems, where electronic devices must dissipate heat via radiative heat transfer. To achieve efficient designs of radiative cooling devices, structural optimization approaches such as topology optimization are required. While existing topology optimization methods have incorporated radiative heat transfer with certain simplifications, fully accounting for multidirectional mutual radiation remains challenging. To address this issue, this study proposes a density-based topology optimization method for conduction-radiation heat transfer problems that accounts for multidirectional mutual radiation. The proposed method integrates a zonal-method-based radiative heat transfer analysis incorporating a ray-tracing method into the finite element heat conduction analysis, capturing radiation effects during the optimization process. By treating the intermediate material densities that arise during the optimization as participating media, the proposed method enables a physically consistent evaluation of radiative heat transfer on implicitly represented structural boundaries. The analytical design sensitivities are derived using the adjoint method, and the accuracy is confirmed by the comparison with the numerical sensitivities obtained by the finite difference method. Numerical examples demonstrate the optimization of radiative heat sinks and radiation shields. The heat sink examples clarify how the balance between conduction and radiation governs the resulting designs, while the radiation shield examples produce multilayer insulation structures that are not obtained by conventional approaches.

</details>


### [178] [Train Often, Deploy Selectively: Forward-Gated Model Replacement in Crypto Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28577)
*Aditya Dutta*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出Shadow Before Swap (SBS)部署策略：在服务路径之外对挑战者模型进行热重拟合，使用延迟标签的下一周数据与持续维护的现有模型进行配对比较，仅在固定配对负对数似然(NLL)优势达到阈值时才提升前者。在Binance两个非重叠时段、48个UTC周、3个种子、8个标底和2种永续合约类型的历史回放中，SBS相比日历替换、计划匹配自动提升和持续维护分别降低NLL 0.1472%、0.0755%和0.0428%，同时将模型部署变更减少78.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产预测系统需要定期重训模型，但重训练出的候选模型并不一定优于持续学习维护中的现有模型。直观的定期替换策略可能引入不必要的模型状态转换，带来风险与成本，因此需要一种更审慎的部署策略来决定"何时替换"。

Method: SBS策略在服务路径之外热重拟合挑战者模型，使用延迟标签对同一周期的数据（下一周）在已维护的现有模型与挑战者之间进行配对评估，只有当挑战者达到固定的成对负对数似然(NLL)优势阈值时才将其提升为生产模型。本质上是一种"影子部署+延迟标签评估+条件提升"的部署策略。

Result: 在历史回放中，SBS相对于三种基线策略均取得NLL改进：相对日历替换降低0.1472%，相对计划匹配自动提升降低0.0755%，相对持续维护降低0.0428%。四周期分块置信区间验证了结果的稳健性。SBS仅推广了528个挑战者中的114个，将部署模型变更减少78.4%同时改善了服务轨迹。该结果在种子、试验预算、提升阈值、早期20资产面板及拓扑匹配的监督目标下保持方向一致。

Conclusion: SBS提供了一种实用的部署策略，能够在不牺牲预测性能的前提下显著减少模型状态转换次数，即在提升概率预测质量的同时限制了可能产生后果的模型状态切换。

Abstract: Production forecasting systems retrain models regularly, but a retrained candidate does not necessarily outperform a continuously maintained incumbent that has continued to learn. We introduce Shadow Before Swap (SBS), a deployment policy that warm-refits a challenger off the serving path, evaluates it against the maintained incumbent on the same next week of delayed labels, and promotes it only after a fixed paired negative-log-likelihood (NLL) advantage.
  In historical replay over two nonoverlapping Binance episodes spanning 48 UTC weeks, three seeds, eight underlyings, and two perpetual-futures contract types, SBS reduces NLL by 0.1472% relative to calendar replacement, 0.0755% relative to schedule-matched automatic promotion, and 0.0428% relative to continuous maintenance. The corresponding episode-stratified four-week block intervals are 0.1139%-0.1754%, 0.0521%-0.0980%, and 0.0301%-0.0554%, respectively. SBS promotes 114 of 528 challengers, reducing deployed model changes by 78.4% while improving the serving trajectory. The effect remains directionally consistent across seeds, trial budgets, promotion margins, an earlier 20-asset panel, and a topology-matched supervised objective. SBS thus provides a practical deployment policy that improves probabilistic forecasts while limiting consequential model-state transitions.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [179] [Complexity of Strong Popularity in Additively Separable Hedonic Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27277)
*Matan Gilboa*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究添加可分享乐博弈（ASHGs）中"强流行划分"的存在性判定问题，证明了该问题是PCW复杂度类完全问题（介于P^NP和S_2^P之间），解决了Brandt和Bullinger（2022）以及Bullinger和Gilboa（2025）提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 享乐博弈中，强流行划分是一个在多数投票中击败所有其他划分的重要稳定性概念。然而，在添加可分享乐博弈这一基础博弈类中，判定强流行划分是否存在一直是一个开放问题。本文旨在理清该问题的精确计算复杂度。

Method: 作者通过归约构造证明，在添加可分享乐博弈（ASHGs）中判定强流行划分的存在性是PCW完全的，其中PCW是Gilboa等人（2025）最近引入的一个介于P^NP和S_2^P之间的复杂度类。

Result: 证明了ASGHs中强流行划分存在性判定问题是PCW完全问题，从而解决了两个此前文献中提出的开放问题。

Conclusion: 该结果精确定位了强流行划分判定问题的计算复杂度，表明这一问题比NP完全问题更复杂（位于P^NP与S_2^P之间），为后续研究提供了坚实的复杂度理论基础。

Abstract: In a hedonic game, agents need to be partitioned into coalitions, and have a preference order over partitions. A partition is called strongly popular if it beats any other partition in a majority vote among the agents. We focus on the fundamental class of additively separable hedonic games (ASHGs), where agents have additive valuations that induce their preferences. We prove that determining the existence of strongly popular partitions in ASHGs is complete for PCW, a recently introduced complexity class which lies in between $P^{NP}$ and $S_2^P$ (Gilboa et al., 2025). This settles an open problem by Brandt and Bullinger (2022) and Bullinger and Gilboa (2025).

</details>


### [180] [A Linear Bound on the Rainbow Cycle Number and Approximate EFX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27455)
*Varun Sivashankar*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了彩虹环数R(d) < ed，即线性上界，从而解决了公平分配中关于R(d)线性的猜想。由此得到每个n个代理人的实例都存在部分(1-ε)-EFX分配，只需O(√(n/ε))个未分配商品，这是彩虹环归约方法能达到的最优渐近保证。同时给出期望多项式时间的随机化算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平分配领域的一个开放问题：是否每个加性估值实例都存在完备的无嫉妒-任意好(EFX)分配？已有研究引入放宽条件，允许部分商品未分配并寻求(1-ε)-EFX分配。彩虹环数R(d)是研究此问题的关键工具，此前最优上界R(d)=O(d log d)导致O_ε(√(n log n))个未分配商品。核心动机是验证R(d)是否具有线性上界，以改进未分配商品数量的渐近保证。

Method: 作者通过证明彩虹环数R(d) < ed（即小于e乘以d，e为自然常数）来解析性地解决R(d)为线性的猜想。基于这一线性上界，将彩虹环归约方法应用于公平分配问题，推导出未分配商品数量的新上界O(√(n/ε))。此外，设计了一个随机化算法，其期望运行时间为输入规模和1/ε的多项式。

Result: 主要贡献：(1) 证明R(d) < ed，解决了R(d)具有线性上界的猜想；(2) 由此得到每个n个代理人的实例均存在部分(1-ε)-EFX分配，仅需O(√(n/ε))个未分配商品，改进此前O_ε(√(n log n))的结果；(3) 证明该结果在彩虹环归约框架下是最优的渐近保证；(4) 提供期望多项式时间的随机化构造算法。

Conclusion: 本文解决了关于彩虹环数R(d)线性性的猜想，将其上界从O(d log d)改进至ed，从而在部分(1-ε)-EFX分配问题上取得了最优渐近结果O(√(n/ε))个未分配商品，并配合高效随机化算法，使这一理论保证具有实际可计算性。

Abstract: It is open whether every fair-division instance with additive valuations admits a complete envy-free-up-to-any-good (EFX) allocation. A well-studied relaxation allows some goods to remain unallocated and asks for $(1-\varepsilon)$-EFX. The rainbow cycle number $R(d)$ was introduced to study this problem: upper bounds on $R(d)$ yield approximate EFX allocations with few unallocated goods. The best previous bound, $R(d)=O(d\log d)$, gives $O_\varepsilon(\sqrt{n\log n})$ unallocated goods. We resolve the conjecture that $R(d)$ is linear by proving $R(d)<ed$. It follows that every instance with $n$ agents admits a partial $(1-\varepsilon)$-EFX allocation with $O(\sqrt{n/\varepsilon})$ unallocated goods. This is the best possible asymptotic guarantee on the number of unallocated goods obtainable from the rainbow-cycle reduction. We also give a randomized algorithm that finds such an allocation in expected time polynomial in the input size and $1/\varepsilon$.

</details>


### [181] [Multi-Player Discrete-Bidding Games; Determinacy, Equilibria, and Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27456)
*Guy Avni,Fatima Murra*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文首次研究了多玩家投标博弈（multi-player bidding games），聚焦于离散投标（discrete bidding）场景。研究表明在温和的平局处理机制假设下，两个联盟之间的投标博弈是确定的（determined），且该确定性可推广到均值支付博弈中的值存在性。基于确定性，证明了定性博弈中纯纳什均衡总是存在。但判定哪个联盟从给定配置获胜的问题在可达性博弈中即使预算以一元表示也是PSPACE-hard的，与双玩家博弈（NP∩coNP）形成鲜明对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双玩家投标博弈已被广泛研究，但多玩家投标博弈此前从未被探索过。多玩家博弈在建模多智能体系统等实际应用中具有重要意义，而离散投标具有实际应用动机和有限配置数的技术优势。作者首次系统研究多玩家投标博弈，旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 论文采用联盟博弈的视角，将多玩家博弈简化为两个联盟之间的对抗。在离散投标框架下，利用配置空间有限的特性，研究了在平局处理机制上的温和假设（如随机或非随机机制）下博弈的确定性。通过确定性结果推导向均值支付博弈的值存在性，并利用博弈论中的标准工具证明纯纳什均衡的存在性。复杂度方面通过归约证明下限。

Result: （1）在温和的平局处理假设下，联盟间的离散投标博弈是确定的；（2）该确定性推广到均值支付博弈的值存在性；（3）定性博弈中纯纳什均衡总是存在；（4）获胜判定问题在可达性博弈中即使预算一元表示也是PSPACE-hard，与双玩家情形（预算二元表示的NP∩coNP）形成显著复杂度差距。

Conclusion: 本文首次揭示了多玩家离散投标博弈的核心理论性质，包括确定性、值的存在性、纳什均衡的存在性以及复杂度下界。结果表明多玩家情形比双玩家情形在计算复杂度上有本质性跳跃（从NP∩coNP到PSPACE-hard），为后续研究多玩家投标博弈提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Games on graphs constitute a fundamental model. Applications include reactive synthesis, which reduces to solving a zero-sum two-player game, and reasoning about multi-agent systems by modeling them as a multi-player game. We study a class of graph games called bidding games in which the players are allocated a budget, and in each turn, an auction determines which player moves the token. Two-player bidding games have been extensively studied. We study, for the first time, multi-player bidding games. We focus on discrete bidding, which imposes granularity restrictions on the players' budgets and bids. The original motivation for discrete bidding is practical applications, and technically, it is appealing that the game has only finitely-many configurations. We initiate our study by considering a game between two coalitions of players. We show that under mild assumptions on the mechanism that is applied to break bidding ties, bidding games are determined: from every initial configuration, one of the coalitions has a winning strategy. Thus, we identify a sub-class of multi-player concurrent games that is determined. We extend the result to existence of a value in mean-payoff games. Using determinacy, we show that a pure Nash equilibrium always exists in qualitative games. Finally, we show that the complexity of deciding which coalition wins from a given configuration is PSPACE-hard already in reachability games and already for budgets given in unary. This is in stark contrast to two-player games, which are known to be in NP and coNP even for budgets given in binary.

</details>


### [182] [Strategy, Not Payoffs: A Behavioural Embedding of Normal-Form Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27536)
*Joshua Caiata,Sreepriya Pulyassary,Xiang Li,Kate Larson*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种轻量级双特征行为嵌入（Nash均衡熵 + 最优响应敏感性），用于预测LLM在不同博弈间微调后的战略能力迁移方向和幅度，证明行为结构而非收益几何决定迁移规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在某一博弈上微调后，其在另一博弈上的推理能力可能提升或退化，但理解和预测这种战略能力迁移是当前的关键挑战。作者希望利用博弈的结构特征来解释和预测微调后的能力变化。

Method: 使用正规式博弈作为测试平台，提出一个轻量级双特征嵌入，包含两个核心行为特征：(1) Nash均衡的熵，刻画博弈结果的不确定性/随机性要求；(2) 最优响应对对手行动的敏感性，刻画策略调整的灵活度需求。将该行为嵌入与已有的结构嵌入进行对比，在留出博弈上预测LLM微调后的能力变化。

Result: 现有发布的结构嵌入主要记忆博弈身份（identity），在泛化到未见过博弈时失败；而提出的行为嵌入能够在留出博弈上可靠预测LLM战略能力的表现变化。

Conclusion: LLM战略能力的迁移不受博弈收益几何形状（payoff geometry）的支配，而是由其所要求的决策行为底层结构所决定。

Abstract: Learning a strategic task changes more than what is directly taught: fine-tuning on one game can either enhance or degrade an agent's ability to reason in another. Understanding and predicting this transfer of strategic capabilities, however, remains a key challenge for large language models (LLMs). Normal-form games provide an ideal testbed for analyzing this phenomenon, as they feature explicitly defined payoffs and well-characterized equilibrium behaviours. In this work, we investigate whether game embeddings can explain and predict changes in LLM strategic capabilities following fine-tuning across different games. We propose a lightweight two-feature embedding that captures fundamental behavioural demands: the entropy of the Nash equilibrium and the sensitivity of optimal responses to an opponent's action. We show that while existing published structural embeddings primarily memorize game identities and fail to generalize, our behavioural embedding reliably predicts performance changes on held-out games. These results demonstrate that the transfer of strategic capabilities in LLMs is not dictated by the payoff geometry of a game, but by the underlying structure of the decision-making behaviour it requires.

</details>


### [183] [Delegated Fair Division](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27743)
*Argyrios Deligkas,Michail Fasoulakis,Stavros D. Ioannidis,Alviona Mancho,Evangelos Markakis*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了一个涉及委托资源分配的公平分配模型，其中不可分割的商品需要分配给隶属于更大中心实体的代理。模型捕捉了资源分配给组织单位、再由组织单位分发给其成员的框架，特别适用于慈善组织分配食品捐赠的场景。每个中心作为其所属代理的代表，协调它们不同的偏好。目标是在中心和代理两个层面同时实现公平。论文区分了两种信息结构（代理与所有代理比较，或仅与同中心的代理比较），并为每种结构提供了高效算法，产生满足两层嫉妒公平性保证的分配方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来引入了委托资源分配的问题，但在该框架下同时考虑中心和代理两个层面的公平性研究尚不充分。特别地，食品捐赠通过慈善组织分配具有巨大的社会影响，需要一种能够协调中央实体（中心）与最终受益者（代理）不同偏好的公平分配方法。

Method: 论文建立了一个分层公平分配模型，其中每个中心代表其所属代理的利益。区分两种信息结构：(1) 代理将他们的捆绑与所有其他代理进行比较；(2) 代理仅与同中心的代理比较。针对每种信息结构，设计了基于嫉妒的公平性保证的高效算法。

Result: 针对两种不同的信息结构，论文都提供了高效算法，能够产生在中心和代理两个层面同时满足基于嫉妒的公平性保证的分配方案。

Conclusion: 论文通过建立分层公平分配框架，展示了在中心和代理两个层面同时实现嫉妒公平性是可行的，为慈善组织和组织单位等委托资源分配场景提供了理论基础和算法支持。

Abstract: Motivated by recently introduced problems on delegated resource allocation, we study a model of fair division, where a set of indivisible goods is to be allocated to some agents, each of which belonging to some bigger central entity. Our model captures the general framework of allocating resources to organizational units, which subsequently distribute them to their affiliated members. A particularly relevant application of this framework, with immense social impact, arises in the allocation of food donations through charitable organizations. In essence, every center acts as the representative of the agents belonging to it, aligning their generally different preferences. Our goal is to distribute the goods in a way that is simultaneously fair both with respect to the centers and the agents. We distinguish two different information structures depending on whether the agents compare their bundles against every agent or only those belonging to the same center. For each one of them we provide efficient algorithms that produce allocations that satisfy envy-based fairness guarantees at both levels.

</details>


### [184] [Reversing Reserve Logic: Optimal Holdback in Local Allocation under Scalable Entry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27817)
*Hiroaki Odahara*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究当账户数量不可信时，面对自动化参与者（机器人）与人类用户竞争的稀缺机会（如演唱会门票、加速器时间）分配问题。作者在匿名筛选规则类别内（忽略账户数、限制负担、仅依赖账户承诺与最强对手、拒绝领先者后不再重新分配），刻画了最大化真实用户期望效用的最优规则。该规则在低拥挤时退款并分配，中等拥挤时保留并分配，而当最强对手处于上尾时则保留并暂缓分配。与传统保留价（拒绝低报价领先者）不同，该规则将异常强的对手视为机器人模仿的证据。本文通过直接对偶证书证明类别最优性，并以基准实验证明上尾暂缓在支持非进入之前即可提升真实用户剩余。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀缺机会（如演唱会门票、加速器时间）可能被自动化参与者（机器人）通过创建大量账户并维持承诺来争夺，超出真实用户的能力范围。由于账户数量不可信，传统机制设计（依赖账户数或简单保留价）无法有效区分真实用户与机器人，因此需要设计一种不依赖账户数量、仅基于承诺水平和对手强度进行筛选的匿名规则，以最大化真实用户的期望效用。

Method: 作者将问题形式化为一种分配机制设计。首先定义一个受限的规则类别：忽略账户总数、对用户保留负担设上限、仅使用账户的承诺水平及其最强竞争对手的信息，且拒绝领先者后不进行重新分配。在此类别内，采用对偶证书（dual certificate）方法直接证明所提规则的最优性。该最优规则按拥挤程度分为三个阶段运作：低拥挤时退款并分配，中等拥挤时保留并分配，当最强对手位于上尾分布时则保留但暂缓分配（即不立即分配给原本可分配的领先者）。作者还通过基准对比实验展示上尾暂缓机制在支持机器人非进入之前即可提高真实用户剩余，并证明了该规则能支撑全承诺与机器人非进入的均衡。

Result: 文章刻画了一个分段式最优匿名筛选规则：在低拥挤状态下退款并分配，在中等拥挤状态下保留并分配，在最强竞争对手位于分布上尾时保留但暂缓分配给合格领先者。该规则不同于传统保留价策略（低出价被拒），而是将异常强的对手视为机器人模仿的信号。通过直接对偶证书证明了该规则在限定类别中的最优性，并通过基准实验验证上尾暂缓可在非进入约束之前提升真实用户剩余。该规则支持一个包含完全承诺与机器人不进入的均衡。

Conclusion: 本文为不可信账户环境下的稀缺资源分配提供了理论最优的匿名筛选规则。核心洞见是：与其用保留价拒绝低质量领先者，不如将异常强的竞争对手视为机器人的信号而暂缓分配至合格领先者。该规则在计算上简洁（仅依赖承诺与最强对手），理论上最优（通过对偶证明），且能自我维持均衡。这一结果为演唱会门票、云计算/加速器时间等存在机器人争抢场景的机制设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Scarce opportunities such as concert tickets and accelerator time may be contested by automated participants that can create accounts and sustain commitments beyond the reach of commitment-limited intended users. When account counts are untrusted, we study anonymous screening rules that ignore them, cap retained burdens, use only an account's commitment and strongest rival, and do not reassign after rejecting the leader. Within this class, we characterize the rule maximizing intended users' expected utility when they commit fully and a scalable entrant stays out. The optimum refunds and allocates at low congestion, retains and allocates at intermediate congestion, and retains while withholding allocation from an otherwise eligible leader when the strongest rival lies in the upper tail. Unlike a conventional reserve, which rejects a low leading bid, this rule treats an unusually strong rival as evidence of entrant imitation. A direct dual certificate proves class optimality; a benchmark shows that upper-tail holdback can raise intended-user surplus before it is necessary to support non-entry. The rule supports an equilibrium with full commitment and entrant non-entry.

</details>


### [185] [Learning to Persuade Privately Informed Receivers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28342)
*I. Arda Vurankaya,Ufuk Topcu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究在线贝叶斯说服问题，其中接收者除了发送者的信号外，还拥有一个发送者无法观测或控制的固定私有信号方案。发送者需要在不了解该私有方案的情况下，通过T轮学习来最小化与知道最优方案时的遗憾，最终实现Õ(T^(3/4))的遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准贝叶斯说服模型假设发送者是接收者唯一的信息来源，但在许多实际应用中，接收者还会参考发送者无法观察或控制的外部信息源。这促使作者研究发送者不知道接收者私有信号方案情况下的在线学习问题。

Method: 作者将学习私有信号方案所导致的指数级信念空间划分问题，简化为一个一维变点检测问题，并基于此设计学习算法来逼近最优信号方案。

Result: 所设计的算法实现了相对于知道接收者私有信号方案的最优方案的Õ(T^(3/4))遗憾界，且对状态空间和接收者信号字母表大小具有多项式依赖。

Conclusion: 该工作为在线贝叶斯说服中处理未知外部信息源提供了首个有效的学习框架，通过低维变点检测的巧妙归约，克服了高维信念空间学习的计算与统计困难。

Abstract: Bayesian persuasion studies how an informed sender can influence the behavior of a receiver through strategic information disclosure. Standard models assume the sender is the receiver's only source of information, yet in many applications receivers also consult external sources the sender can neither observe nor control. We study an online Bayesian persuasion problem in which a binary-action receiver has access to a fixed signaling scheme that is unknown to the sender. Over $T$ rounds, the sender commits to a signaling scheme and sends a signal; the receiver combines it with its private signal and acts, while the sender observes only the action. We design a learning algorithm that achieves regret $\widetilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ relative to the optimal scheme of a sender who knows the private signaling scheme of the receiver, with polynomial dependence on the sizes of the state space and the receiver's signal alphabet. Our key insight is reducing the problem of learning the exponentially large belief-space partitioning induced by the private scheme to a one-dimensional change-point detection problem.

</details>


### [186] [Agents That Certify Their Own Exploits: Confidence-Scheduled Restricted Responses for Safe Opponent Exploitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28520)
*Boning Li,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出CS-RNR方法，这是首个在两人零和不完全信息博弈中，其安全性保证（安全证书）基于实际部署策略而非对手模型的方法。CS-RNR使用随时有效的置信序列追踪对手动作频率，当置信区间与均衡参考分离时才认定可被利用的频率，并通过受限响应求解生成候选反制策略，在部署前对完整策略树进行全树最优响应审计，将与预算对比的证书与策略原子性提交。在Leduc扑克中，CS-RNR的稳态收益是资金验证二元门方法的6.2倍，在所有36,000手审计牌局中均满足报告的安全证书公差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在两人零和不完全信息博弈中，执行纳什均衡策略虽然保证了博弈值，但无法从对手的缺陷中获取额外价值。然而，检测和利用对手的偏离行为面临两难：二元发布规则可能因证据不足而无所作为，而对不完整对手模型的完全最优响应又可能被高度利用（可被反利用）。现有方法缺乏一种既能安全利用对手缺陷、又能对实际部署策略提供可验证安全保证的方案。

Method: CS-RNR方法由三个关键部分组成：(1) 使用随时有效的置信序列跟踪对手的池化动作频率，仅当频率的置信区间与均衡参考分离时，才将该频率认定为"可被利用"的；(2) 将已确认的偏离构建为保守的对手模型，通过受限响应求解在一系列针水平（pin levels）网格上生成候选反制策略；(3) 部署前对每个完整候选策略进行全树最优响应评估，生成安全证书并与用户指定的预算比较，随后与策略原子性地提交。

Result: 在Leduc扑克中，CS-RNR的稳态收益是资金验证二元门方法的6.2倍，同时保证每个部署的策略均在预算范围内。当使用相同的估计器结合轨迹混合方法时，收益达到预算的13.6倍。在Leduc、Liar's Dice和5-rank Leduc三个博弈上，所有36,000手被审计的牌局均满足报告的安全证书公差。

Conclusion: CS-RNR解决了对手利用中的核心安全-收益权衡问题：通过在部署策略上计算可验证的证书（而非依赖对手模型的质量），模型质量决定可获得的利用程度，而证书严格约束参考相对期望损失。这种方法将"利用什么"和"如何保证安全"解耦，实现了比现有方法更高的安全收益。


Abstract: An agent playing a Nash-equilibrium strategy in a two-player zero-sum imperfect-information game secures the game value but forfeits the additional value offered by a flawed opponent. Diffuse deviations pose a particular challenge: binary release rules may gather too little evidence to act, while a full best response to an incomplete opponent model can be highly exploitable. We introduce \emph{budget-constrained confidence-scheduled restricted responses} (CS-RNR), the first opponent-exploitation method whose safety guarantee is a certificate the agent computes on the strategy it actually deploys, so that every exploit it commits to is one it has audited itself. The method tracks pooled action frequencies with anytime-valid confidence sequences and treats a frequency as exploitable only once its interval separates from an equilibrium reference. The confirmed deviations define a conservative opponent model, which a restricted-response solve turns into candidate counter-strategies over a grid of pin levels. Before deployment, each complete candidate is evaluated by a full-tree best response. The resulting certificate is compared with a user-specified budget and committed atomically with the strategy. Because this check is performed on the played strategy, model quality determines the exploitation achieved while the certificate controls reference-relative expected loss. In Leduc hold'em, CS-RNR obtains $6.2\times$ the steady-state gain of a money-verified binary gate while keeping every deployed strategy within budget. A trajectory mixture using the same estimator reaches $13.6\times$ the budget. Across Leduc, Liar's Dice, and 5-rank Leduc, all $36{,}000$ audited hands satisfy the reported certificate tolerance.

</details>


### [187] [Algorithms for Structured Elections under Thiele Voting Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28575)
*Alexandra Lassota,Krzysztof Sornat*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了批准制委员会选举中Thiele投票规则的获胜者确定问题的计算复杂性。作者首先分析了最优解在投票者批准集诱导下的结构约束，并在此基础上为Voter Interval (VI)域上的比例批准投票（PAV）及其他Thiele规则设计了FPT算法。此外，还解决了两项公开问题：当每位候选人至多被两位选民批准时的多项式时间算法，以及以获胜委员会总分数为参数的FPT算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Thiele投票规则是一类重要的委员会选举规则，其获胜者确定问题在一般情况下是NP难的。PAV在Voter Interval域上的计算复杂性是领域内核心开放问题之一。理解最优解的结构约束并对受限但自然的VI域设计高效算法，有助于推进对这一问题的理解，并解决文献中的公开问题。

Method: 首先，作者基于每位候选人被哪些选民批准（即选民的批准投票如何诱导候选人之间的依赖关系）来分析固定Thiele投票规则下获胜委员会的结构约束。利用这一结构分析，作者为PAV及其他Thiele规则在Voter Interval域上设计FPT算法，并针对两位不同参数（其中一个是使一般实例NP-hard的参数）证明其FPT性。同时，针对每位候选人至多被两位选民批准的特殊实例设计了多项式时间算法。

Result: 证明了每个Thiele规则在VI域上对于某一参数都是FPT的，而该参数在一般实例中即使取常数值也导致NP-hard。解决了PAV在VI域计算复杂性这一开放问题的部分关键方面。此外，为每位候选人至多被两位选民批准的实例提供了多项式时间算法，并为以获胜委员会总分数为参数的情形提供了FPT算法，回答了两项文献中的公开问题。

Conclusion: 本文通过结构分析与FPT算法设计，显著推进了对Thiele投票规则（特别是PAV）在Voter Interval域上计算复杂性的理解，同时解决了两项公开问题。这些结果为委员会选举中受限但自然的输入域上的高效计算提供了新工具和新视角。

Abstract: We study the computational complexity of winner determination problems in approval-based committee elections under Thiele voting rules. These form a class of rules parameterized by a fixed weight vector that specifies how a voter's satisfaction depends on the number of approved candidates elected. We first analyze the structure of optimal solutions based on the sets of voters who approve each candidate---that is, how voters' approval ballots induce dependencies between candidates---revealing constraints on a winning committee under any fixed Thiele voting rule. Using this, we design FPT algorithms for Proportional Approval Voting (PAV) and other Thiele rules on a natural restricted domain known as the Voter Interval (VI) domain---that is, after a suitable ordering of voters, each candidate is approved by a consecutive interval of voters. In particular, we show that every Thiele rule on VI is FPT with respect to a parameter for which the problem is NP-hard on general instances, even when the parameter takes constant values. Our results advance the understanding of the computational complexity of PAV on Voter Interval instances, which remains one of the central open questions in this area. We further resolve two open questions from the literature on PAV (and other Thiele voting rules) by providing a polynomial-time algorithm for instances where each candidate is approved by at most two voters, and an FPT algorithm parameterized by the total score of a winning committee.

</details>


### [188] [The Complexity of Kemeny Aggregation with Three Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28588)
*Péter Madarasi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了Kemeny规则相关问题的计算复杂度：对于恰好三个未加权排名，即使每个候选对都以2:1分裂，Kemeny Score仍是NP完全的；赢家、唯一赢家及可能/必然优先级问题是Θ₂^p完全的；识别Kemeny最优或唯一最优聚合是coNP完全的。研究确立了固定配置规模的完整分类，并推广到Slater序、置换中位数及Mallows模型中的最大似然中心排名。此外还构造了NP完备性的六副本构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kemeny规则是聚合排名的经典方法，但其计算复杂度在小型固定配置（特别是恰好三个排名）下尚未完全确定。理解这些边界情况有助于揭示Kemeny规则计算难度的本质来源，并为实际应用中的算法设计提供理论指导。

Method: 作者通过构造硬实例来完成复杂度证明：硬实例诱导的多数锦标赛的多数维数恰好为3；归约过程中还能从最优Kemeny分数精确确定最大割值，并从任何Kemeny最优聚合恢复最大割。对于固定的q≥3和⌈q/2⌉≤s≤q，最小成对支持度s给出了尖锐的二分类：当3s≤2q时为NP完全/Θ₂^p完全/coNP完全；当3s>2q时多数锦标赛是传递的，其唯一拓扑序就是唯一Kemeny最优聚合。此外，六副本构造用于证明三个两两等距排名情形下Kemeny Score和Kendall-Tau Center的NP完备性。

Result: 得到了完整的固定配置规模分类：在3个排名且每对候选2:1分裂时，Score问题是NP完全的；赢家、唯一赢家、可能/必然优先级问题是Θ₂^p完全的；识别问题是coNP完全的。支持度s的尖锐二分法也得到证明。六副本构造中，N个输出候选的共同距离为(2/3)C(N,2)，这是等距三元组的最大可能距离，并给出了两个最优值的仿射公式、刻画了所有Kemeny最优输出序。

Conclusion: 本文对Kemeny规则在固定小规模配置下的计算复杂度给出了完整、精确的分类，揭示了即使在极少量排名（三个）和极不平衡的支持度（2:1）下问题依然困难。结果同时推广到Slater序、置换中位数和Mallows模型，具有广泛的理论意义。等距三排名情形还建立了输入与输出的Kemeny唯一最优性之间的等价关系。

Abstract: The Kemeny rule aggregates rankings by minimizing their total Kendall-tau distance from an aggregate order. We prove that Kemeny Score is NP-complete for exactly three unweighted rankings, even when every candidate pair is split $2$-to-$1$. On the same profiles, the winner, unique-winner, and possible- and necessary-precedence problems are $Θ_2^p$-complete, while recognizing a Kemeny-optimal or uniquely Kemeny-optimal aggregate is coNP-complete. The hard instances induce tournaments of majority dimension exactly $3$. The reduction also determines the exact maximum-cut value from the optimal Kemeny score and recovers a maximum cut from any Kemeny-optimal aggregate. For every fixed $q\geq3$ and $\lceil q/2\rceil\leq s\leq q$, minimum pairwise support $s$ yields a sharp dichotomy: the score problem is NP-complete, the winner and precedence problems are $Θ_2^p$-complete, and the recognition problems are coNP-complete when $3s\leq2q$; for $3s>2q$, the majority tournament is transitive and its unique topological order is the unique Kemeny-optimal aggregate. Exact support $s$ suffices in the hard case when $s>q/2$, and supports in ${s,s+1}$ suffice when $s=q/2$. These results give complete fixed-profile-size classifications and transfer to Slater orders, permutation medians, and maximum-likelihood central rankings in the Mallows model. Finally, a six-copy construction proves NP-completeness of both Kemeny Score and Kendall--Tau Center for three pairwise-equidistant rankings that still split every pair $2$-to-$1$. For $N$ output candidates, their common distance is $\frac23\binom N2$, the largest possible for an equidistant triple. The construction gives affine formulas for both optimal values, characterizes all Kemeny-optimal output orders, and shows that the output has a unique Kemeny-optimal order and a unique center exactly when the input has a unique Kemeny-optimal order.

</details>

### [189] [Learning features from Newton's algorithm: a way to accelerate nonlinear parametrized PDE solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28036)
*Rémy Vallot,Florian de Vuyst,Thibault Dairay,Mathilde Mougeot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段牛顿初始猜测策略，通过参数空间采样和学习预计算解的数据库，构建两个互补的降维空间（解特征空间和校正搜索方向特征空间），用回归模型预测代理解，再通过GMRES求解残差最小化校正，最终作为高保真牛顿法的高质量初始猜测，显著减少牛顿迭代次数和CPU时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 牛顿法的收敛速度高度依赖于初始猜测的质量，初始猜测越接近真实根，收敛越快。现有的代理初始化方法（如仅用回归模型预测解）精度有限，导致牛顿法仍需多次迭代才能收敛，计算开销大。作者希望提出一种更高效的初始猜测生成策略，在保持弱侵入性的同时进一步降低迭代次数和计算成本。

Method: 该方法包括两个阶段：(1) 利用离散牛顿轨迹构建两个互补的降维空间——由收敛状态构建解特征空间，由中间牛顿增量构建校正搜索方向特征空间；对未知参数，用回归模型预测代理解近似。(2) 采用基于GMRES的残差最小化校正方法，仅需残差评估和小规模最小二乘问题的求解，得到校正后的状态作为高保真牛顿法的初始猜测完成收敛。

Result: 在代表性PDE问题上的数值实验表明，该策略相比独立的代理初始化方法能减少牛顿迭代次数并降低总CPU时间，实现了可量化的加速，且观察到显著的加速效果。

Conclusion: 该两阶段牛顿初始猜测策略是一种通用的、弱侵入式的方法，可广泛应用于大规模非线性问题，在保持可迁移性的同时显著提升计算效率。

Abstract: It is well known that Newton's method converges faster when the initial guess is closer to a root of a system of nonlinear equations. In this paper, a two-stage Newton initial guess strategy is proposed by learning features from a parameter-space sampling and a database of precomputed solutions. The method uses discrete Newton trajectories to construct two complementary reduced spaces: a solution feature space, built from converged states, and a corrective search direction feature space, built from intermediate Newton increments. For an unseen parameter, a regression model is used to predict a surrogate solution approximation. Then, in a second step, a residual-minimizing correction is computed using a dedicated GMRES-based approach. The resulting state is then used as an initial guess for the high-fidelity Newton method, which completes convergence. The corrective step is computationally inexpensive since it only requires residual evaluations and the solution of a small least-squares problem. The methodology is weakly intrusive once the high-fidelity residual fields and a script-based programming interface are available. This strategy reduces the number of Newton iterations and decreases the overall CPU time. Numerical experiments on representative PDE problems show quantifiable speedups compared with standalone surrogate initialization. Significant speedups are observed. This generic approach can be applied to a broad class of large-scale nonlinear problems.

</details>


### [190] [Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27251)
*Kart-leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对工程设计中常用的Transformer代理模型在低维小样本数据集上过度参数化导致过拟合的问题，提出并系统评估了三种递归Transformer范式（Tiny Recursive Model、Depth Recursive transformer、简单递归transformer），在半导体封装热-机械可靠性分析和Laplace PDE电容场求解两个工程预测任务上验证了递归权重共享Transformer能在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间取得有效平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Transformer在工程设计中替代昂贵的第一性原理仿真时，因工程数据集通常规模小、维度低，而标准Transformer架构参数过多，导致过拟合而非精度提升，同时带来不必要的内存和计算开销。因此需要从"增加可学习参数"转向"增加额外计算"的架构设计思路。

Method: 提出并评测三种递归Transformer范式：a) Tiny Recursive Model，b) 提出的Depth Recursive transformer，c) 简单递归transformer。通过硬件感知的系统性比较，评估预测性能（Recall、Mean Reciprocal Rank）、参数数量和计算复杂度（FLOPs），在两个低维工程预测任务上验证：（1）先进半导体封装的热-机械可靠性分析（热循环下的应力和翘曲，需在昂贵FEA下重复评估）；（2）Laplace PDE迭代数值求解器用于电容场计算。

Result: 实验结果表明递归权重共享Transformer在低维小样本工程数据上能够实现有效的精度-参数-计算成本权衡，避免了传统Transformer的过度参数化问题。具体预测性能通过Recall和MRR指标在两项工程任务上得到验证。

Conclusion: 递归权重共享Transformer为小数据工程代理建模提供了一种既有效又可泛化的替代方案，能在预测精度、参数效率与计算成本之间实现良好平衡，并为资源受限场景下递归Transformer架构选择提供了实用设计指南。

Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.

</details>


### [191] [Regularizing modality contribution drift in multimodal continual learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27260)
*Zhen Zhang,Jielei Chu,Bin Liu,Tianrui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出模态贡献漂移（MCD）概念及其量化指标，并设计持续模态贡献漂移正则化（CMCDR）方法，通过保留旧任务的模态贡献结构来缓解多模态持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。CMCDR同时提供基于重放和无重放两种版本，在多种多模态持续学习场景中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MMCL方法主要关注跨模态表示对齐或语义相似性，但忽略了各模态的相对贡献及其交互在增量任务中是否保持稳定。这种"决策层面的漂移"（即MCD）未被现有方法有效解决，需要专门的正则化机制来缓解。

Method: 首先提出MCD分数来量化模态贡献漂移，结合模态子集干预下的贡献强度与相对依赖变化。基于此设计CMCDR：重放版本利用存储的旧样本作为诊断探针，对比当前模型与冻结旧模型的贡献分布并约束旧样本的模态特定与交互贡献变化；无重放版本则用当前任务样本作为探针，蒸馏冻结旧模型的旧任务贡献响应，无需样本即可正则化贡献分布。

Result: 在模态类增量学习和持续视觉问答两类任务上的实验验证了CMCDR的通用性和有效性；理论和实证分析也解释了为何现有MMCL方法无法可靠缓解MCD。

Conclusion: CMCDR通过显式约束模态贡献结构的稳定性，弥补了现有MMCL方法对决策层模态贡献漂移的忽视，在有无旧样本回放两种设置下均能有效缓解多模态持续学习中的遗忘问题。

Abstract: Multimodal continual learning (MMCL) aims to learn emerging knowledge from multimodal data while preserving knowledge. To mitigate forgetting, current MMCL methods usually focus on cross-modal representation alignment or semantic similarity, but they overlook whether the relative contributions of individual modalities and their interactions remain stable across incremental tasks. We term this decision-level shift Modality Contribution Drift (MCD) and quantify it with the MCD score, which combines contribution-strength and relative-reliance changes under controlled interventions on modality subsets. Theoretical and empirical analyses further explain why current MMCL methods cannot reliably mitigate this drift. To this end, we propose Continual Modality Contribution Drift Regularization (CMCDR), which preserves the modality contribution structure of previously learned tasks. Since MMCL settings differ in whether old exemplars are available, CMCDR includes both replay-based and replay-free versions. The replay-based version uses modality-subset interventions as diagnostic probes on stored old samples, compares their contribution profiles between the current model and a frozen previous model, and constrains changes in old-sample modality-specific and interaction contributions. The replay-free version uses current-task samples as probes and distills the frozen model's old-task contribution responses, thereby regularizing the observed contribution profile without exemplars. Experiments on multimodal class-incremental learning and continual visual question answering validate the generality and effectiveness of CMCDR.

</details>


### [192] [DoTime: A Synthetic Benchmark Generator for Interventional and Counterfactual Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27263)
*Dennis Thumm,Billy Tim Anthony,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DoTime，一个开放、可扩展且理论上严谨的多元时序结构因果模型（TSCM）生成器，支持干预和反事实估计，并发布为dotime PyPI包及四套冻结评估套件。它新增了连续时间干预窗口、带正性保护的反事实采样、机制切换SCM、非平稳动力学及确定性干预画像等能力，并验证了干预训练相比等容量观测模型在方向准确性上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列因果推断基准大多基于观测性数据、规模小或领域特定，导致在医疗、政策评估和气候科学等关键场景中，干预性和反事实估计缺乏充分的评测基准与工具支持。

Method: DoTime以多元时序结构因果模型（TSCMs）为核心，构建可生成干预数据的理论框架；支持连续时间干预窗口、带正性守护的反事实采样模式、作为中断时间序列严格泛化的机制切换SCM、通过切换SCM参数实现的非平稳动力学，以及将趋势和结构断点置于评估窗口内的确定性斜坡和正弦干预画像。此外以因果基础模型参考实现验证其作为先验的适用性。

Result: 发布的套件涵盖10万条轨迹训练规模快照及八种具名识别结构，每种结构均含精确真值（同SCM的配对干预轨迹及连续时间套件中的共享噪声反事实）。在结构匹配的留出片段评估中，干预先验拟合网络（PFN）在所有结构、轨迹长度和训练种子上均呈现正的准确性差距。

Conclusion: 干预训练相比等容量观测模型在方向准确性上具有可测量的优势，该可证伪论断在全部测试条件下得到验证，表明DoTime作为因果基础模型的先验生成器具有实际价值。

Abstract: Most benchmarks for causal inference over time series are observational, small, or domain-specific, leaving interventional and counterfactual estimation under-served exactly where it matters most, such as in healthcare, policy evaluation, and climate science. We introduce \textbf{DoTime}, an open, scalable, and theoretically grounded generator of multivariate temporal structural causal models (TSCMs) with interventions, released as the \code{dotime} PyPI package together with four frozen evaluation suites. Beyond existing work, it adds capabilities absent from prior generators: continuous-time intervention \emph{windows}, counterfactual sampling modes with a positivity guard, regime-switching SCMs as a strict generalization of interrupted time series, non-stationary dynamics by construction with switching SCM parameters, and deterministic ramp and sinusoidal intervention profiles that place trends and structural breaks \emph{inside} the evaluation window. Moreover, it demonstrates the suitability of the generator as a prior for a causal foundation model reference implementation. The released suites span a training-scale snapshot of $100{,}000$ trajectories and eight named identification structures, each with exact ground truth: paired interventional trajectories from the same SCM throughout, and shared-noise counterfactuals in the continuous-time suite. We ship reference baseline implementations with an evaluation harness, and pose a falsifiable claim: interventional training buys a measurable direction-accuracy advantage over an observational model of identical capacity. It is tested across three training seeds per arm. Under structure-matched evaluation on held-out episodes, the interventional prior-fitted network's (PFN) gap is positive in every structure, trajectory length, and seed tested.

</details>


### [193] [PlatformBid: An Auto-Bidding Benchmark from a Unified Advertising Platform's Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27265)
*Shengtian Yang,Yewen Li,Peng Jiang,Zhiyi Lyu,Bo An,Peng Jiang,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PlatformBid，这是首个从统一广告平台视角设计的自动出价（auto-bidding）综合基准，涵盖同质竞争、异质竞争和促销竞争三种代表性场景，系统性评估了从经典控制方法、强化学习方法到生成式方法的多种现有自动出价算法，并提出基于流匹配（flow-matching）的新型方法BidFlow。在快手平台上的在线实验显示目标成本提升0.68%，验证了PlatformBid离线与在线一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自动出价算法仅从DSP（需求方平台）单侧出发，目标是最大化广告主转化率，但在当前大型广告平台（如社交媒体和电商平台）已将SSP、DSP和Ad Exchange功能内部整合的背景下，平台方的目标不仅是最大化广告主转化，还包括平台总营收。然而，目前缺乏从统一平台视角出发的评估框架，这成为推动自动出价研究发展的迫切需求，也是本文的出发点。

Method: 本文提出PlatformBid基准框架，定义三种代表性真实场景：(1)同质竞争——所有广告主使用相同算法；(2)异质竞争——广告主采用多样化的算法策略；(3)促销竞争——部分广告主在促销活动（如黑色星期五）期间加码预算以提升销量。在此基础上，系统评估涵盖经典控制方法、基于强化学习的方法和近期生成式方法的多种现有自动出价算法。同时提出BidFlow，一种基于流匹配的新型自动出价方法，利用流匹配方法的表达力强的策略表示来有效应对动态竞争环境。

Result: 在快手上进行的在线实验显示，BidFlow相对于基线在目标成本上实现了+0.68%的改进，为PlatformBid的离线与在线一致性提供了部署层面的实证证据。同时，系统评估揭示了不同类别自动出价方法在三种设定下的性能表现差异。

Conclusion: PlatformBid作为首个统一广告平台视角的自动出价基准，填补了现有评估框架的空白，为自动出价研究提供了更贴近实际业务场景的评测标准。基于流匹配的BidFlow方法展示了生成式建模在自动出价领域的潜力，且在线实验结果验证了该基准框架的有效性和一致性。

Abstract: Real-time bidding is central to computational advertising, comprising three elements: Supply Side Platform (SSP) selling ad impressions, Demand Side Platform (DSP) bidding for advertisers, and Ad Exchange conducting auctions between them. Traditional auto-bidding algorithms focus solely on the DSP side, maximizing advertiser conversions by adjusting bids against competitors. However, current big ad platforms, such as social media and e-commerce companies, now integrate SSP, DSP, and Ad Exchange functions internally. From such ad platforms' perspective, the goal of the auto-bidding algorithms is not only to maximize the advertisers' conversions, but also the total revenue of the platform. Given the lack of platform-centric evaluation frameworks and the pressing need to advance auto-bidding research, we propose PlatformBid - the first comprehensive benchmark designed from a unified ad platform's perspective. To accurately reflect the real-world auto-bidding scenarios, we define three representative settings: (1) homogeneous competition with identical algorithms across advertisers, (2) heterogeneous competition with diverse algorithmic strategies, and (3) promotional competition where some advertisers surge budgets for boosting sales during promotional events like Black Friday. We systematically evaluate a broad spectrum of existing auto-bidding methods across these settings, encompassing classical control methods, RL-based methods, and recent generative methods. Besides these methods, we further propose a novel auto-bidding method based on flow-matching, termed BidFlow, which leverages the flow-matching method's expressive policy representation to effectively handle dynamic competitive environments. Online experiments on Kuaishou further show a +0.68\% improvement in target cost, providing deployment evidence for the offline-online consistency of PlatformBid.

</details>


### [194] [Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27269)
*Weiye Shi,Fanxu Meng,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出端到端（E2E）功能重构方法，将MHA/GQA模型转换为MLA注意力后，通过优化转换后的MLA模块以复现原始模型的输出投影响应，从而提升推测解码（speculative decoding）中草稿令牌的接受率。实验覆盖192种配置，在37/64个匹配任务单元中显著提升接受率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLA因其紧凑的潜在状态替代增长的KV缓存、降低长上下文LLM推理的解码内存流量而日益重要，但多数开源检查点使用MHA/GQA。直接转换会引入注意力函数误差（低秩分解和RoPE处理），这种误差在独立生成时可能可容忍，但在推测解码中会显著降低草稿令牌接受率，限制了转换后MLA的加速效果。

Method: 将MLA草稿构建视为功能重构而非缓存压缩：提出端到端（E2E）方法，在转换后对每个MLA注意力模块进行优化，以在标定隐藏状态上复现原始MHA/GQA模块经过输出投影后的响应。该方法与转换器无关、属于转换后处理流程，保留转换后的缓存和推理图，且不需要验证器logits或监督。

Result: 在192个模型-转换器-后端-方法-任务配置上评估，涵盖Llama/Qwen的4个草稿-目标对、TransMLA和MHA2MLA转换器、HF和vLLM后端以及4个200提示任务。以0.5个百分点报告公差计，功能重构在64个匹配任务单元中显著改善37个，26个基本不变，仅1个显著下降。

Conclusion: 功能重构方法能够有效恢复转换后MLA模块与原始MHA/GQA的注意力函数一致性，从而大幅提升推测解码中的草稿令牌接受率，是一种无需重训练、不依赖验证器监督且与转换器/后端无关的通用后处理方案。

Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and target verification. We find that direct MHA/GQA-to-MLA conversion can sharply reduce this agreement: low-rank factorization and RoPE handling introduce attention-function errors that may be tolerable for standalone generation but substantially lower draft-token acceptance. We therefore formulate MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction rather than cache compression. Our end-to-end (E2E) method optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of its original MHA/GQA counterpart on calibration hidden states. This converter-agnostic post-conversion procedure preserves the converted cache and inference graph and requires neither verifier logits nor verifier supervision. We evaluate 192 model-converter-backend-method-task configurations spanning four Llama/Qwen draft-target pairs, TransMLA and MHA2MLA, HF and vLLM, and four 200-prompt tasks. With a 0.5-percentage-point reporting tolerance, Functional Reconstruction materially improves acceptance in 37 of 64 matched task cells, leaves 26 practically unchanged, and materially decreases one. Code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/swyhahaha/FunctionalMLA.

</details>


### [195] [RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27271)
*Huihao Jing,Haozhe Cui,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Changxuan Fan,Yuxuan Liu,Hanyu Yang,Sirui Zhang,Ziyi Chen,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLPF（基于性能反馈的强化学习），通过分阶段奖励机制将执行结果转化为训练信号，使代码智能体不仅通过测试还能优化程序运行效率，在PerfCodeBench上将正确且可运行率从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码模型越来越多地使用执行反馈进行训练，但大多数训练信号止步于正确性，忽略了两个程序即使通过相同测试也可能在运行时间上差异巨大的问题。对于系统代码而言，效率是重要但常被忽视的优化维度。

Method: 提出RLPF框架，将执行结果转化为分阶段奖励：失败的程序按执行进展排序，正确的程序则根据相对基准的改进程度（向专家参考靠拢）进行排名。这样既能在正确性达成前提供有意义的反馈，也能在正确性达成后提供对性能敏感的反馈。

Result: 在PerfCodeBench上微调Qwen3-32B，正确且可运行解决方案从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。训练后的模型与更强的开放权重系统相当，优化行为可适度迁移到EffiBench-X。消融实验表明模型生成的参考提供有用但较弱的监督，完整组合奖励比仅正确性或仅运行时的基线更可靠。

Conclusion: 代码智能体不仅可以被训练来通过测试，还可以被训练来优化其生成的程序。RLPF证明了利用性能反馈训练代码模型的有效性，填补了执行反馈仅停留在正确性层面的空白。

Abstract: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks, and gives little guidance when most sampled programs fail to compile or run. We propose \textbf{RLPF}, reinforcement learning from performance feedback, which turns execution outcomes into a staged reward. Failed programs are ordered by execution progress, while correct programs are ranked by their relative improvement from the baseline toward the expert reference. This gives useful feedback before correctness and performance-sensitive feedback after correctness. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with RLPF on PerfCodeBench raises correct-and-runnable solutions from $11.1\%$ to $54.6\%$ and improves relative efficiency from $8.1\%$ to $38.6\%$. The trained model becomes competitive with stronger open-weight systems, and its optimization behavior transfers modestly to EffiBench-X. Additional studies show that model-generated references provide useful but weaker supervision, and that the full composite reward is more reliable than correctness-only or runtime-only baselines. These results suggest that code agents can be trained not only to pass tests, but also to optimize the programs they write.

</details>


### [196] [SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27273)
*Jinliang Gao,Ning Yang,Hai Wang,Baili Xiao,Pin Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SDO（结构感知数据组织）框架，通过暴露驱动的反馈机制动态组织小批量组成和样本暴露频率，利用KNN邻域遍历和暴露均衡调度，在不产生额外预热开销的情况下加速大模型后训练收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型后训练成本高昂，现有效率提升方法主要关注样本选择和训练调度，但数据组织本身被视为静态预处理步骤。基于嵌入的分组方法在训练前构建固定分区，无法适应优化过程中样本暴露的演化，导致所有样本获得相似的暴露量而忽视其不同优化需求——部分样本被冗余更新，部分样本欠优化。

Method: SDO包含两个核心机制：（1）epoch内局部性感知批处理：通过KNN邻域遍历形成连贯的小批量；（2）跨epoch暴露均衡调度：记录每个样本的参与次数，降低过度暴露样本的采样概率以保持长期覆盖。SDO逐epoch运行在冻结的外部嵌入上，避免模型预热训练开销，属于即插即用框架。

Result: 在SFT、DPO和GRPO三种训练范式下，SDO均加速了收敛，早期到中期阶段收益最大。SDO产生更连贯的梯度，并在不同问题类型间实现更均衡的准确率，同时不会永久排除任何训练样本。

Conclusion: SDO通过将静态的数据组织结构转化为动态、暴露感知的自适应机制，有效解决样本暴露不均问题，在不牺牲训练覆盖的前提下提升后训练效率和效果。

Abstract: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leading to redundant updates for some samples while leaving others under-optimized. To address this problem, we propose SDO (Structure-Aware Data Organization), a plug-and-play data organization framework with an exposure-driven feedback mechanism that organizes mini-batch composition and sample exposure according to representation-space structure. SDO operates epoch by epoch on frozen external embeddings, avoiding model warm-up training overhead: within each epoch, locality-aware batching forms coherent mini-batches via KNN neighborhood traversal; across epochs, exposure-balanced scheduling records per-sample participation and reduces the sampling probability of over-exposed samples to preserve long-term coverage. Across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, SDO accelerates convergence, with the largest gains observed in the early-to-mid phase, producing more coherent gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types without permanently excluding training samples.

</details>


### [197] [Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27274)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Zeyuan Li,Zhiyi Lu,Jiacheng Hao,Youlang Du,Zhen Jiang,Xinche Zhang,Yuhao Sun,Sen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BridgeMIL，一种两阶段框架，将实例表示学习与主题级监督解耦。第一阶段通过时间邻近窗口对齐和子袋内采样进行预训练，避免继承实例标签；第二阶段将编码器迁移到注意力MIL聚合器，仅对主题预测施加监督。在三个EEG疾病数据集和五个骨干网络上，14/15设置中取得最高平均准确率，总体平均准确率76.57%，比最强基线高4.28个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG疾病诊断需要每次预测一个受试者，但常见流程将记录分割成短实例并继承受试者标签进行实例级分类，假设所有实例具有同等的诊断证据可靠性。MIL避免了继承标签问题，但EEG数据集的受试者数量远少于实例数量，限制了端到端MIL学习的表示质量。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 阶段1在不使用继承实例标签的情况下预训练编码器，通过时间邻近窗口对齐和独立采样的受试者内子袋进行预训练，利用方差和协方差正则化防止表示崩溃并减少冗余，无需负样本对。(2) 阶段2将预训练编码器迁移到基于注意力的MIL聚合器，仅对受试者预测施加监督，并通过特征保留机制限制表示漂移。

Result: 在三个EEG疾病数据集和五个代表性骨干网络上，BridgeMIL在15个数据集-骨干设置中的14个取得最高平均准确率，总体平均准确率76.57%，较最强基线高出4.28个百分点。进一步分析表明：实例继承标签的可靠性存在显著变化；性能对受试者稀缺性比实例稀缺性更敏感；表示空间结构更清晰，具有受试者级聚类和更好的诊断类别分离。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，在从大量EEG实例中学习时，需要将监督与受试者级预测目标对齐，而非将疾病标签分配给单个实例。BridgeMIL通过解耦实例表示学习和受试者级监督有效提升了EEG疾病诊断性能。

Abstract: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

</details>


### [198] [Persistent Gaussian Perturbations Prevent Oversmoothing in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28185)
*Mostafa Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种在每一步传播后注入高斯噪声的循环图神经网络，将其建模为随机动力系统。在确定性更新的全局收缩假设下，证明了隐表示构成几何遍历的马尔可夫链，并建立了平稳状态下Dirichlet能量的显式正下界，该下界与噪声方差和图谱间隙成正比，从而从理论上保证渐近过平滑被防止。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过平滑是深度图神经网络（GNNs）的基本局限：重复的消息传递会使节点表示趋同，最终坍塌至低维子空间，限制了消息传递架构的有效深度。现有解决策略（残差连接、归一化、图重连）均为确定性方法，本文旨在探索随机扰动作为一种替代机制来对抗过平滑。

Method: 将循环GNN视为随机动力系统，在每个传播步骤注入独立高斯噪声；在确定性更新的标准全局收缩假设下，证明了隐表示形成的马尔可夫链是几何遍历的且具有唯一不变概率测度；通过理论推导给出了平稳期望Dirichlet能量的显式正下界。

Result: 理论结果表明：平稳期望Dirichlet能量的下界与噪声方差及图谱的谱间隙成正比，因此平稳表示不会坍塌到常数流形上，即渐近过平滑被严格防止。数值实验在线性和非线性循环GNN上均与理论预测高度吻合，验证了平稳分布的出现及Dirichlet能量对噪声强度的依赖关系。

Conclusion: 持续随机扰动构成了一种从根本机制上不同于现有确定性方法（残差连接、归一化、图重连）的抗过平滑手段，为设计深度图神经网络提供了新的理论支撑和实用思路。

Abstract: Oversmoothing is a fundamental limitation of deep graph neural networks (GNNs), where repeated message passing causes node representations to become increasingly similar, eventually collapsing toward a low-dimensional subspace. This phenomenon limits the effective depth of message-passing architectures and motivates the search for mechanisms that preserve representation diversity. In this paper, we study a recurrent graph neural network in which independent Gaussian noise is injected after every propagation step and analyze the resulting architecture as a stochastic dynamical system. Under a standard global contraction assumption on the deterministic update, we prove that the hidden representations form a geometrically ergodic Markov chain admitting a unique invariant probability measure. Our main theoretical result establishes an explicit positive lower bound on the expected stationary Dirichlet energy, proportional to both the noise variance and the spectral gap of the underlying graph. Consequently, the stationary representations cannot collapse onto the constant manifold, providing a rigorous guarantee that asymptotic oversmoothing is prevented in the sense of non-vanishing Dirichlet energy. Our analysis reveals persistent stochastic perturbations as a fundamentally different mechanism for combating oversmoothing, complementing existing deterministic approaches based on residual connections, normalization, and graph rewiring. Finally, numerical experiments on both linear and nonlinear recurrent graph neural networks closely match the theoretical predictions, illustrating the emergence of a stationary distribution and the predicted dependence of the limiting Dirichlet energy on the noise intensity.

</details>


### [199] [Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27275)
*Jiwon Jang,Kisu Yang,Heuiseok Lim,Hyunwoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对4比特权重量化在多轮工具调用智能体上的影响，本文发现标准指标（任务奖励）显示量化几乎无损，但过程分析揭示量化会放大模型已有的失败模式（如工具名幻觉），幅度高达2.5倍。分数保持平坦是因为基准测试的十错误预算吸收了额外失败；将预算缩小到两个错误后，仅在量化增加错误量的单元中暴露17分的差距。作者建议在任务奖励旁同时报告每通道错误率和小预算下的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化到4比特权重被广泛报道接近无损，但这一宣称往往基于标准指标。多轮工具调用智能体是量化当前最重要的应用场景，需要在该场景下严格检验这一宣称，并深入过程层面理解量化对模型行为的影响。

Method: 在τ²-bench上，对两个开放权重模型家族（dense和MoE变体）在两个领域进行实验，共8个单元、每单元456个episode，覆盖16/8/4比特权重。使用标准指标（任务分数）和过程诊断（错误类型、错误量、每通道错误率、缩小错误预算测试、等价检验、秩相关分析），并进行针对性错误修复提示验证因果机制。

Result: 标准指标上量化看似免费：8个单元中无一在多重比较校正后出现显著分数变化，最大过程损伤单元中分数变化被等价检验界定在±7.5点内。但过程层面，量化将模型在满精度下已有的失败（电信领域的工具名幻觉、零售领域实体错误同趋势）放大了最多2.5倍（每任务+17.6点），且基本不产生新失败类型（失败集秩相关≥0.94，仅0.18%新事件）。将错误预算从10缩小至2后，仅在量化增加错误量的单元中暴露17分的差距；针对性错误修复提示仅在该损伤位置精确移除伤害。

Conclusion: 标准任务分数会掩盖量化对智能体的实际过程损伤。论文建议在报告任务奖励的同时，报告每通道错误率和缩小预算下的成功率——这两者均可从基准测试已有日志中获取，作为更敏感的量化质量诊断指标。

Abstract: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest process damage, equivalence testing bounds the change within $\pm$7.5 points. The process tells a different story. Quantization amplifies the failure the model already exhibits at full precision (tool-name hallucination in telecom, with the same directional trend in retail entity errors) by up to 2.5$\times$ in volume (+17.6 points per task), while creating essentially no new failures. The failure set is the same at every precision (rank correlation $\geq$ 0.94, 0.18% novel events). The score stays flat because the benchmark's ten-error budget absorbs the extra failures. Shrinking the budget to two errors re-exposes a score gap of 17 points, and it does so only in the one cell where quantization added error volume, exactly as the masking account predicts. A targeted error-repair prompt, run for five telecom models at every precision, removes the damage exactly and only where it lives. Both diagnostics, the per-channel error rate and success under a shrinking budget, come from logs benchmarks already collect; we suggest reporting them alongside task reward.

</details>


### [200] [Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding on Sparse Graphs at the Nishimori Temperature for Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28428)
*V. S. Usatyuk,D. A. Sapozhnikov,S. I. Egorov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Kohn-Sham谱嵌入（KSSE），一种基于物理启发的能量模型，用稀疏图谱嵌入替代稠密CNN分类器，在ImageNet-1000上以约21.24M参数达到88.93% Top-1准确率，超越Swin-L并匹敌ViT-H，模型规模分别缩小10倍和30倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统稠密CNN分类器参数开销大且缺乏可解释性，作者希望利用物理启发的稀疏图结构（Random-Bond Ising模型）替代密集分类头，在保持甚至提升精度的同时大幅降低模型足迹。

Method: KSSE将预训练特征映射到准循环LDPC图，构造正则化Laplacian作为Kohn-Sham哈密顿量，利用FFT在循环块上求解D个独立通道谱问题（O(N log N + k²_mode N)），通过star-domain surgery优化图拓扑（构造边移位产生局部凸性并限制残余阻挫），并基于多重分形分析（D₂谱）验证从粗糙区域到星域盆地相的景观转变。论文证明六个理论结果：广义Ihara-Bass恒等式、陷阱集特征值对应、加性通道可分性、手术定理、拟平稳扰动界和不动点收敛定理。

Result: 在ImageNet-1000转导协议下（冻结EfficientNet-B4特征，D=1792），KSSE以约21.24M参数达到88.93% Top-1准确率，超越Swin-L（197M, 86.4-87.3%）并匹敌ViT-H/14（632M, 88.0-89.5%），模型足迹分别缩小10倍和30倍。

Conclusion: KSSE证明了以稀疏图谱嵌入为基础的能量模型可以在极小参数预算下匹敌甚至超越大规模Transformer分类器，为轻量级高精度分类提供了一条物理启发的新路径。

Abstract: We introduce Kohn--Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE), a physics-inspired energy-based model replacing dense CNN classifiers with a sparse-graph spectral embedding evaluated at the Nishimori temperature of an associated Random-Bond Ising Model. By mapping pre-trained features onto quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check graphs and constructing a regularized Laplacian acting as a Kohn--Sham Hamiltonian, we solve $D$ independent channel spectral problems in $\mathcal{O}(N\log N + k^2_{\text{mode}} N)$ time via FFT on circulant blocks (leveraging Pontryagin self-duality of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$) and low-order Rayleigh refinement. Graph topology is optimized using \emph{star-domain surgery}: rather than destroying information-carrying codewords by removing frustrated cycles, we construct edge shifts creating local convexity around codewords while bounding residual frustration to $ρ(B_γ)\leq 1+δ$. Multi-scale fractal analysis ($D_2$ spectrum) and fractal learning-rate landscape certifies a landscape transition from rough regimes ($D_2>3$) to star-domain basins ($D_2<1$), enabling Rayleigh refinement with $k_{\text{mode}}=5$ modes. We prove six theoretical results: a generalized Ihara--Bass identity linking belief propagation to the Laplacian; trapping-set eigenvalue correspondence; additive channel separability with an explicit exchange-correlation bound; a surgery theorem bounding frustration with attractor width $Ω(1/\sqrt{d_{\min}})$; a quasi-stationarity perturbation bound; and a fixed-point convergence theorem. In a transductive protocol on ImageNet-1000 with frozen EfficientNet-B4 features ($D=1792$), KSSE achieves \textbf{88.93\%} Top-1 accuracy using $\approx 21.24$M parameters, outperforming Swin-L (197M, 86.4--87.3\%) and matching ViT-H/14 (632M, 88.0--89.5\%) under standard inductive setups, while reducing model footprint by $10\times$ and $30\times$, respectively.

</details>


### [201] [The Kinetics of Training: A Driven-Nucleation Rate Law for Emergence, Plasticity Loss, and Circuit Control in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27281)
*Lei Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了语言模型能力涌现的关键机制：一条能力电路的各部分必须在单次"随机尝试"中对齐才能生效，这种"无部分学分"的联合对齐是能力形成的限速步骤。作者通过多种实验和理论证明，该机制遵循一个率方程（sites × attempts × drive × exp(-βK) minus destruction），并由此发展出可预注册、可预测的能力出现时间方法，同时定位了破坏可学性的损伤（头部提交到基础数据）并提出了修复方案（仅重初始化QK切片）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型中能力涌现的底层机制，特别是为什么能力会在某一训练步骤突然出现（而非渐进提升），以及如何预测和控制这种涌现过程。

Method: 通过两个指纹实验验证"无部分学分联合对齐"假设：(1)在无捷径装置中比较五部件电路与三部件电路缺失三部分时的等待时间；(2)在Pythia模型上对七种能力和三种规模进行消融实验。提出率方程模型，并通过前向（预测能力点火时间）、后向（延迟学习的临界点）、机制验证（受控门控注意力模型）三个预注册实验验证。

Result: 实验证明：缺失部件数决定等待时间而非电路大小；消融一个部件平均保留17%能力（部分学分预测50-83%，p=2e-10）。前向实验在10/10案例中成功点火、0/12案例在浓度阈值以下不点火，五种数据预测误差5%。后向实验显示超过临界步骤后能力永不点火，但验证损失平滑下降。修复实验显示仅重初始化query-key切片即可恢复可学性（6/6），value切片无效（0/6）。

Conclusion: 能力涌现的本质是电路各部件在同一随机尝试中对齐这一罕见事件，其壁垒随缺失部件数指数增长。该框架提供了可预测、可控制能力出现时间的方法，并可用于诊断和修复模型的可学性问题，而标准监控指标（如验证损失）对此失灵。

Abstract: A capability appears in a language model when the last parts of its circuit align in one stochastic attempt, and getting all but one right is worth nothing. We show this no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step of capability formation. Two fingerprints: in a shortcut-free apparatus a five-part circuit missing three waits as long as a three-part circuit missing three (1.19-1.37), so the wait counts missing parts, not size; and on Pythia across seven capabilities and three scales, ablating one part leaves a median 17% of the capability in 32 of 32 discriminating cells, where partial credit predicts 50-83% (p = 2e-10), while a random non-part head leaves 100%.
  One rare event whose barrier grows with missing parts yields a rate equation -- sites x attempts x drive x exp(-beta*K), minus destruction -- read three ways, each preregistered with frozen constants. Forward: a capability flat at baseline ignites at a step of our choosing once the mix passes a concentration floor (10/10 above, 0/12 below), and while still flat its arrival is datable from its precursor to 5% median error on six held-out models. Backward: the delay to learn a withheld capability grows with waiting until, past a critical step, it never ignites -- yet validation loss falls smoothly throughout, so standard monitors are blind to it. We locate the damage (heads commit to the base data) and isolate the cure: re-initializing only the query-key slices restores learnability (6/6) while the value slices do nothing (0/6). We prove the mechanism in a controlled gated-attention model: occupation forces a deadline whose consequences need no mixing assumption. Completed: SGD's noise fails the fluctuation-dissipation test, so we install one and anneal, melt and pin circuits on schedule. Scope: conjunction circuits in transformers to 1.4B.

</details>


### [202] [The Role of Causality in Algorithmic Recourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28497)
*Srikanth Avasarala,Varun Gupta,Shahin Jabbari,Saber Salehkaleybar,Juba Ziani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于因果表现性框架的算法救济方法，解决传统算法救济策略忽视真实资格改善、仅追求预测翻转所导致的策略博弈和模型失效问题。通过结构因果模型建模救济行为对特征和真实标签的传播效应，证明了在特定条件下因果感知的救济策略能收敛到表现性稳定的均衡解，减少博弈动机并降低重复重训练需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算法救济方法（algorithmic recourse）大多只关注翻转模型预测结果，而未考虑推荐的行为改动是否真正提升个体资质，还是仅仅让个体"博弈性"地欺骗分类器。这导致部署的救济策略会诱发不良行为响应，降低预测精度，并在模型重训练后失效。作者旨在形式化这一失败模式，并设计考虑因果结构的救济策略来缓解该问题。

Method: 作者提出一个因果表现性框架来形式化救济策略。具体方法包括：(1) 通过结构因果模型（SCM）建模救济行为在特征间及对真实标签的传播效应；(2) 将因果响应下的优化问题刻画为非凸优化问题，并分析其性质；(3) 刻画表现性稳定解（performatively stable solution）存在及可高效计算的充分条件；(4) 提出简单的迭代动力学算法以求解稳定的因果救济策略，并与传统的经验风险最小化（ERM）方法进行对比实验。

Result: 实验在半合成数据和真实信贷数据集上进行。结果表明：忽略因果结构的救济策略会诱发大规模、错位的行为响应，而因果救济策略能收敛到稳定的均衡解，显著减少博弈动机。所提方法在性能上一致优于标准经验风险最小化，同时减少因策略性智能体行为导致的分布偏移而引发的重复模型重训练需求。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了将因果结构纳入算法救济设计的重要性：因果感知的救济策略不仅能实现表现性稳定，还能有效抑制个体博弈行为，提升模型的长期预测效能和鲁棒性，为高危险分类场景（如信贷审批）中的救济系统设计提供了理论基础与实践验证。

Abstract: Algorithmic recourse aims to provide individuals with actionable changes to improve their predicted outcomes in high-stakes classification settings, such as loan and mortgage applications. However, most existing approaches focus only on flipping a model's prediction, without accounting for whether the recommended changes lead to genuine improvement in an individual's true qualifications or merely enable strategic gaming of the classifier. Consequently, deployed recourse policies can induce behavioral responses that degrade predictive accuracy and become ineffective after model retraining.
  In this work, we formalize this failure mode through a causal performative framework for recourse. We model how recourse actions propagate through a structural causal model, capturing interactions among features as well as their effect on the true label. These causal responses induce a non-convex optimization problem, even under standard convex losses. We characterize conditions under which performatively stable solutions exist and can be efficiently computed via simple iterative dynamics. Our analysis reveals that recourse policies that ignore causal structure can induce large, misaligned behavioral responses, whereas causal recourse leads to stable equilibria that reduce incentives for gaming. Experiments on both semi-synthetic and real credit datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms standard empirical risk minimization while reducing the need for repeated model retraining to accommodate distribution shifts caused by strategic agent behavior.

</details>


### [203] [Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27283)
*Chao Peng,Zhiheng Lyu,Peijie Dong,Hande Dong,Qiang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种评估长时程任务失败的方法论，主张通过"地平线残差"（horizon residual）来区分长任务失败的两种原因：普通错误随阶段累积，以及轨迹诱导退化（如上下文腐烂）。作者认为，要声称"长时程失败"，必须将完整任务成功率与基于短阶段个体表现的基线预测进行对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程基准测试通常仅显示"任务越长，智能体越容易失败"的观察结果，但这种观察无法解释失败的根本原因。失败可能源于更多阶段导致普通错误累积，也可能源于长任务包含更难的个体决策，或者是由于对话历史、工具输出和环境变化积累而使后续工作更难（即轨迹诱导退化/上下文腐烂）。作者希望提出一种严谨的评估框架来区分这些可能性。

Method: 作者提出了一套对比方法：(1) 将完整实际任务成功率与从短、独立阶段构建的基线预测进行比较；(2) 使用完整任务成功率与基线预测之比的log值定义为"地平线残差"；(3) 对比必须使用相同的智能体配置，并预先规定阶段划分、检查点、信息流和预算的选择方式。地平线残差能表明全量演播与所选基线不同，但解释失败原因仍需针对性实验。

Result: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），并未给出实验数据结果，而是提出了一个概念框架和方法论主张：只有通过比较完整任务成功率与基于短阶段构建的基线预测，才能合理地声称存在"长时程失败"；地平线残差用于量化实际全量演播与基线之间的差异。

Conclusion: 作者认为，长时程失败需要在严格定义的对比条件下验证，即同一智能体配置下，将完整演播的成功率与基于短阶段个体表现的基线预测进行比较。地平线残差虽能识别出完整任务与基线之间的差异，但解释差异产生的原因仍需要进一步的针对性实验。这项工作为长时程智能体评估提供了更严格的方法论基础。

Abstract: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later work harder. When the harmful accumulation is specifically the text visible to the model, it is often called context rot. In this position paper, we argue that to claim a "long-horizon failure", benchmarks must compare actual full-task success against a baseline prediction built from short, individual stages. We call the log-ratio between this prediction and actual success the horizon residual. The comparison must use the same agent configuration and specify in advance how stages, checkpoints, information, and budgets will be chosen. The residual shows that the full rollout differs from the chosen baseline; targeted experiments are still needed to explain why.

</details>


### [204] [TIER-MoE: Trust-Informed Expert Routing via Conditional Modality Risk for Multimodal Fusion in Biomedical Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27289)
*Yu Chang,Anzhe Cheng,Chenwei Wu,Zhuoran Wang,Jiahao Chen,Tamoghna Chattopadhyay,Sophia I. Thomopoulos,Paul M. Thompson,Liyue Shen,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TIER-MoE，一种风险引导的子空间混合专家模型，通过样本特定模态可靠性（基于OUT-OF-FOLD预测损失）与专家特定子空间兼容性实现稀疏模态-专家路由，在四类多模态生物医学数据集上优于SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合虽可结合互补证据，但更多证据并不总是带来更好的预测。现有模型虽通过跨模态交互和样本自适应融合取得了进展，但无法揭示某模态在融合中被分配的影响力是否源于其不可靠、冗余或与专家不匹配。需要一种方法显式建模模态的样本级可靠性。

Method: TIER-MoE是风险引导的子空间混合专家模型。它将模态可靠性定义为该模态单峰预测器预期产生的预测损失（即风险），该风险通过学习未在对应样本上训练的模型（out-of-fold）生成的预测来估计。模型将估计的风险与专家特定子空间兼容性相结合，用于稀疏的模态-专家路由；同时设置始终激活的共享路径以保持多模态互补性。

Result: 在四个公开的多模态生物医学数据集（涵盖阿尔茨海默病状态、皮肤病变恶性程度和视网膜分类）上，TIER-MoE在预测性能和概率校准方面均优于现有最先进方法，在Macro-F1和Brier分数上保持一致改进，并在外部队列上展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 风险引导的模态可靠性估计能有效识别不可靠或冗余的模态来源，结合子空间混合专家架构可显著提升多模态融合的预测性能与校准质量，并在跨队列场景中保持良好泛化性。

Abstract: The promise of multimodal fusion lies in combining complementary sources of evidence, yet more evidence does not always yield a better prediction. Recent multimodal models have advanced fusion through richer cross-modal interaction and sample-adaptive fusion. However, the influence assigned to a modality during fusion does not reveal whether that source is unreliable, redundant, or poorly matched to a specialized expert. To address this limitation, we introduce TIER-MoE, a risk-guided subspace mixture-of-experts model that defines sample-specific modality reliability as the prediction loss its unimodal predictor is expected to incur. This risk is learned from out-of-fold predictions generated by models that were not trained on the corresponding sample. TIER-MoE combines the estimated risk with expert-specific subspace compatibility for sparse modality-expert routing, while an always-active shared path preserves multimodal complementarity. We evaluate TIER-MoE on four public multimodal biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease status, skin-lesion malignancy, and retinal classification. Results demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in predictive performance and probability calibration, with consistent improvements in Macro-F1 and Brier score and strong zero-shot generalization to an external cohort.

</details>


### [205] [EvoCause: LLM-Guided Evolution of Causal Graphs for Root Cause Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27290)
*Lei Zan,Keli Zhang,Shifeng Xie,Jiale Zheng,Zehao Xiao,Zhiwei Dong,Ke Zhang,Ruichu Cai,Malik Tiomoko,Lujia Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoCause框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）根据专家标注的根因诊断结果对因果图进行语义合理的边编辑，再通过确定性代码验证节点身份和无环性，在标注对齐集上保留最优图，从而缩小因果图推断与专家知识之间的差距。同时发布了TeleRCA基准数据集，包含来自生产电信网络的485,681条告警事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有根因分析（RCA）方法从观测日志中学习一个固定的因果图，并在故障引发的子图中预测所有零入度告警作为根因。然而，该图一旦学习完成便保持不变，无法从历史故障的专家诊断中获益，导致RCA精度受限。

Method: EvoCause采用"LLM提议+确定性验证"的闭环框架：专家标签仅约束哪些告警应为源节点但不指定具体的边编辑；LLM提出语义上合理的图编辑候选，随后由确定性代码验证节点身份与有向无环性（DAG），并在带标签的对齐集上保留最优图。测试时仅使用精化后的图进行透明预测，无需LLM调用。

Result: 在合成数据上，EvoCause以PC因果发现算法初始化，相比未精化的PC基线，Node F1、Case EM和Graph F1分别提升11.59、9.40和4.59个百分点，nSHD降低0.2379。在TeleRCA基准上，将可读的告警标题替换为匿名标识符会导致Node F1和Case EM分别下降6.12和8.04个百分点，表明告警名称信息对图精化具有显著贡献。

Conclusion: EvoCause有效弥合了因果发现与专家知识之间的鸿沟，通过LLM辅助的图编辑显著提升了RCA性能，同时保持测试阶段无需LLM调用的高效透明性。告警名称的语义信息是图精化过程中的关键因素，为实际生产环境中的因果图完善提供了可行路径。
