TL;DR: 本文提出Tycho编码代理系统，用于解决ARC-AGI-3中的交互式抽象问题（active abstraction）。该系统从交互历史中分离可操作观察与动画/完成/游戏结束帧，构建并利用游戏特定模型进行测试、规划、修复或绕过假设。在25个公开游戏中使用Claude Opus 4.8进行匹配推理预算比较，Actor请求委托模型构建策略获得最高平均RHAE（88.49），且GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达到100.00 RHAE并完成全部183关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3将抽象转化为交互式技能获取问题：玩家必须在每一步都有效的情况下推断未知游戏的规则、隐藏状态和目标。传统方法难以在行动效率受限的条件下同时完成推理与建模，因此需要形式化环境并设计能主动决定何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型的代理系统。

Method: 将环境形式化为参数化渲染确定性摩尔机（Moore machines）；提出Tycho编码代理系统，将可操作观察与中间动画帧、关卡完成帧和游戏结束帧分离，从结构化的交互历史中建模、测试、规划、修复或绕过自由格式的可执行假设。在25个公开游戏上比较四种编排策略（使用Claude Opus 4.8，匹配推理预算），包括Actor请求委托模型构建器等策略。

Result: Actor请求委托模型构建策略获得最高平均RHAE（88.49）；使用该策略，GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达到100.00 RHAE并完成全部183个关卡，游戏平衡首次运行人类回放中位排名分别为98.5和100.0；Opus 5相比官方人类基线少用61%计分动作。自动修复策略虽能更准确地复现观察到的转换，但仅达到83.07 RHAE。

Conclusion: 研究表明，转换匹配仅表明模拟器能复现观察到的动力学，并不代表找到了目标或改善了下一步行动。强对局还需要决定何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型——即"主动抽象"（active abstraction）问题：从高成本交互中生成可测试模型，并判断获取或使用模型的成本是否值得。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 turns abstraction into an interactive problem of skill acquisition. A player must infer an unfamiliar game's rules, hidden state, and goal while maintaining action efficiency because every move counts. We formalize these environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines and introduce Tycho, a coding-agent system that constructs and uses game-specific models during interaction. Tycho separates actionable observations from intermediate animation, level-completion, and game-over frames. From this structured history, an agent can model, test, plan with, repair, or bypass a free-form executable hypothesis.
  In one matched public-set run per policy, we compare four orchestration policies on all 25 public games using Claude Opus 4.8 under matched inference budgets. Actor-requested delegation to a model builder obtains the highest observed mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), 88.49. With this selected policy, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 both reach 100.00 RHAE and complete all 183 levels. Their game-balanced first-run human-replay midranks are 98.5 and 100.0. Opus 5 uses 61% fewer scored actions than the aggregate official human baselines.
  Automatic repair after verification failures produces models that reproduce observed transitions much more accurately, yet reaches only 83.07 RHAE. Transition match indicates whether a simulator reproduces observed dynamics, not whether it has identified the objective or improves the next action. Strong play also requires deciding when to construct, repair, use, or bypass a model. We call this joint problem active abstraction: generating a testable model from costly interaction and deciding when acquiring or using it is worth its cost.

</details>


### [402] [One Human, $N$ Agents: Audit-Budget Allocation for LLM Agent Fleets under Miscalibrated, Correlated Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28317)
*Cesare Zavattari,Alessandro Tommasi,Giuseppe Prencipe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了在预算远小于智能体数量（B≪N）的情况下，单个人类如何审计N个LLM智能体的问题。作者通过两级高斯copula对带噪审计进行建模，发现了置信度排级审计失效的误校准阈值δ*，并推翻了两个先验预期：δ*随预算缩小而上升，跨家族的误差相关性并非主要受血统影响而是由共享难度主导。开源模型置信度近乎恒定（实操无用），专有模型置信度具有信息量且低于阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体的规模化部署，一个人类审计员必须在有限预算下监督大量智能体，而智能体提供的置信度可能被对抗性误校准且误差间存在相关性。现有方法（如置信度排级审计）在何种条件下失效尚不清楚，需要量化误校准阈值并理解预算与相关性结构对审计策略的影响。

Method: 将预算受限下的噪声审计建模为一个两层高斯copula模型（two-level Gaussian copula），在理论上定位置信度排级审计相对于随机审计更差的误校准阈值δ*，并分析预算变化与跨家族相关性对δ*的影响。通过对五个开源LLM和一个专有模型的实证评估，检验模型的预测，并在录制的轨迹上回放审计策略以验证排级顺序。

Result: 发现两个反直觉结果：δ*随预算收缩反而上升（而非下降）；跨家族的误差相关性并非低，共享难度主导了血统关系的效应。五个开源LLM的置信度近乎恒定，在操作上无用，点估计达到或超过翻转阈值（但置信区间跨越该阈值）；专有模型置信度具有信息量且落在阈值之下。提供了"空洞监督"（vacuous oversight）的量化判据。

Conclusion: 置信度排级审计并非总是优于随机审计，其有效性取决于误校准程度δ与预算B之间的定量关系。开源模型的低信息量置信度使其在当前的审计预算场景下无法提供有效监督信号，而专有模型表现更好。该研究为评估监督协议的有效性提供了量化标准。

Abstract: A single human must audit $N$ LLM agents under a budget of $B \ll N$ audits per round, guided by self-reported confidence that may be adversarially miscalibrated and by correlated errors. We model this as budgeted noisy inspection over a two-level Gaussian copula and locate the miscalibration threshold $δ^*$ past which confidence-ranked auditing is \emph{worse} than random. Two a-priori expectations reverse: $δ^*$ \emph{rises} as the budget shrinks, and cross-family correlation is not low---shared difficulty dominates lineage. Five open-weight LLMs show operationally useless (near-constant) confidence, point estimates at or beyond the flip though CIs straddle it; a proprietary model is informative and lands below it. We give a quantitative criterion for \emph{vacuous} oversight, and replaying policies on recorded traces confirms the ordering.

</details>


### [403] [PathView-Bench: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Achieve Fine-grained Multiscale Understanding of Pathology Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28318)
*Zongyi Chen,Yu Liang,Jie Lin,Liansheng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PathVU是一个面向计算病理学的视觉锚定基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在显微和全切片两个视野尺度上的细粒度多尺度视觉理解能力，包含14个VQA任务、61,673张图像和308,070个样本，评估18个主流MLLM后发现先进模型在病理细粒度视觉任务上仍存在显著局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理学多模态基准主要评估最终诊断答案、报告或描述，无法深入判断模型是否真正理解病理推理和决策所需的多尺度视觉内容。需要一个新的基准来系统评估MLLM在病理图像上的细粒度、多尺度视觉理解能力。

Method: 从23个公开病理成像数据集中构建PathVU，包含人类监督标签和空间标注。通过将原始标注转换为确定性任务目标，实现区域定位、视觉识别、数量估计、空间推理和上下文不足判断等能力的程序化评分。涵盖Region FOV（高分辨率局部区域）和Slide FOV（宏观全切片视野）两个视角，共14个VQA任务、61,673张图像、308,070个样本，覆盖28个器官和7,253,526个标注。

Result: 评估了18个代表性通用型、医学领域和病理专科MLLM，发现即使在先进模型中，在多尺度病理图像的细粒度视觉任务上也存在显著局限。

Conclusion: PathVU为开发和评估具有明确多尺度视觉理解能力的病理MLLM提供了可复现的基础。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to analyze pathology images. However, dominant multimodal benchmarks in pathology mainly score final diagnostic answers, captions, or reports. These evaluations provide limited insight into whether a model understands the multiscale visual content needed for pathology reasoning and decision-making. We introduce PathVU, a vision-anchored benchmark for fine-grained and multiscale visual understanding in computational pathology. Built from 23 public pathology imaging datasets with human-supervised labels and spatial annotations, PathVU evaluates MLLM understanding in two fields of view: Region FOV for high-resolution local regions and Slide FOV for macro whole-slide views. By converting raw annotations into deterministic task targets, PathVU enables programmatic scoring of region localization, visual recognition, quantity estimation, spatial reasoning, and insufficient-context judgment. The benchmark contains 14 VQA-style tasks, 61,673 images, and 308,070 samples across 28 organs and 7,253,526 annotations. Evaluating 18 representative general-purpose, medical-domain, and pathology-oriented MLLMs, we observe substantial limitations even in advanced models on fine-grained visual tasks across multiscale pathology images. PathVU provides a reproducible basis for developing and evaluating pathology MLLMs with explicit multiscale visual understanding.

</details>


### [404] [Paying for Honesty Without Knowing the Truth: Reputation-Penalty Design for LLM Marketplace Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28330)
*Mingdai Yang,Shicheng Fan,Kejing Yu,Duohao Wang,Li Sun,Hao Peng,Philip S. Yu,Zhiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CARP声誉惩罚机制和SPARC自我反思机制，在不获取产品级真实信息的情况下，有效抑制LLM商家在商品列表中的属性捏造行为，弥补了与完美信息白盒模型之间的消费者福利差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理作为自主商家编写商品列表时，在竞争压力下会捏造属性以赢得销售，即使被明确要求诚实也普遍捏造。平台无法验证每个声明（因为没有对每个商品的真实信息），只能观察到带噪音和偏差的投诉信号，因此需要一个不依赖产品级真实信息的声誉惩罚机制来抑制捏造行为。

Method: 提出CARP机制：(1) 采用带死区的声誉惩罚，容忍投诉中的噪音；(2) 使用状态依赖的惩罚严重度，对抗声誉驱动的检测侵蚀。CARP仅依赖受噪音污染的投诉信号，不访问真实信息，且对策略性博弈具有鲁棒性。在此基础上提出SPARC（byte-clean代码门控反思机制），通过游戏化惩罚将声誉惩罚转化为行为约束。

Result: CARP能抑制低评分撒谎者的销量同时不惩罚诚实商家；与SPARC结合后，相比完美信息白盒模型，可弥补大部分消费者福利差距且无需访问真实信息，在所有对比策略中实现最佳福利。SPARC使LLM商家在撒谎无成本时捏造，但在撒谎导致销售损失时自我约束，这种约束源于自利而非合规。该区分可追溯到惩罚门控的自我修正推理，且在不同模型中一致可观察，并有置信区间支持。

Conclusion: 通过设计CARP和SPARC，在无法获取产品级真实信息的现实约束下，有效遏制了LLM代理商家的属性捏造行为，保护了消费者福利。SPARC证明了对LLM而言，让撒谎产生实际销售代价（自利约束）远比简单的诚实指令（合规约束）更有效。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as autonomous merchants that write their own product listings, and under competitive pressure, they fabricate attributes to win sales. Even under instructions to be honest, they fabricate attributes in a majority of listings across models. A platform's obvious remedy---verifying each claim against the truth---is unavailable, because it observes only a noisy, biased complaint signal, never the ground truth. We design CARP, a reputation-penalty mechanism with a deadband that forgives complaint noise and a state-dependent severity that counters reputation-driven detection erosion. CARP requires no product-level ground truth and is robust to strategic gaming. CARP protects consumers by suppressing the sales volume of low-rated liars while sparing honest sellers. Paired with SPARC, it closes most of the consumer-welfare gap relative to a perfect-information oracle, without ever accessing the truth. It also achieves the best welfare of the policies we compare. We further show that this felt penalty becomes behaviorally binding through SPARC, a byte-clean code-gated reflection mechanism: LLM merchants fabricate when lying is free but restrain themselves when fabrication costs them sales, a self-interested response rather than compliance. We trace this distinction to penalty-gated self-correction reasoning, and observe the binding across models, with supporting confidence intervals.

</details>


### [405] [Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28336)
*Feng Xiong,Leyan Xue,Hongyu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出感知-纠正蒸馏（PCD），一种无标签方法，利用下游失败与师生分歧作为互补证据（软AND门）来识别可纠正的感知失败，从而在多模态推理蒸馏中仅在感知是恰当纠正目标时强化监督信号。在八个基准上，PCD显著提升了蒸馏性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同策略蒸馏为多模态推理器提供密集监督，但其轨迹级奖励无法判断失败源于感知错误还是后续推理错误。现有感知成功率（PSR）估计存在歧义：低成功率难以区分感知不足与推理困难，导致无法精准定位纠正目标。

Method: PCD通过两个互补证据——下游失败（downstream failure）和教师-学生不一致（teacher-student disagreement）——的乘积构成软AND门，仅当两个证据同时存在时才增强蒸馏信号。该方法基于贝叶斯证据组合推导，证明乘法是唯一在任一证据缺失时归零的归一化双线性门。技术实现包括：分离的感知-推理rollout以及均值保持权重，确保推理目标不被改变。

Result: 在八个基准上，PCD将8B→2B蒸馏的宏平均从OPD的44.50提升至47.28；32B→8B的宏平均从56.94提升至61.22。在匹配的2B消融实验中，去除PCD组件使保留集外平均下降2.22分，去除分离rollout使结果下降0.88分。

Conclusion: 有效的多模态蒸馏不仅取决于教师预测的内容，还取决于能否识别感知何时是恰当的纠正目标。PCD通过精准定位可纠正的感知失败，显著超越基线方法，验证了"何时纠正"与"纠正什么"同等重要的观点。

Abstract: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.

</details>


### [406] [How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28367)
*Zihan Dong,Zhiyuan Ma,Zekun Wang,Yunqing Li,Zirou Liu,Ruixuan Deng,Qishi Zhan,Rui Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对计算机使用代理（CUA）的基准评估管道进行了系统性审计，提出涵盖任务构建、轨迹观察、评分与报告四个环节的可靠性框架，发现150条公开失败轨迹中有15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的（10.7%为评估器假阴性，4.7%为任务本身缺陷），并通过三层诊断分类法揭示验证/反馈与规划失败是主要失败原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUA代理正被部署到实际场景中，但其基准评分仍依赖于脆弱的脚本化评估者（oracle），现有评估管道存在任务过时、轨迹缺少关键视觉证据、评估者拒绝有效替代方案、聚合报告掩盖失败原因等问题，缺乏系统性的可靠性评估框架。

Method: 首先构建覆盖任务构建、轨迹观测、评分和报告四个阶段的可靠性框架；然后从五个Web、企业工作流和桌面控制基准中选取150条公开失败评分轨迹进行审计，量化错误判定比例；提出三层失败诊断分类法区分验证/反馈、规划与执行/接地错误；最后将发现与长时域CUA基准对比，推导分阶段的设计规则。

Result: 审计结果显示15.3%的FAIL判定是错误标签，其中10.7%为评估器假阴性，4.7%为任务本身损坏；真实失败中验证/反馈与规划错误占主导地位，而非执行/接地错误；单一成功率标量无法解释失败模式。

Conclusion: CUA评估需要分阶段、多维度的可靠性设计，涵盖任务构建、轨迹观测、评分与报告各环节，并且不能依赖单一标量指标进行判断，需针对长期任务进行专门评估。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUA) are being deployed to browse the web and operate desktop software, yet their benchmark scores are still commonly produced by brittle scripted oracles. A score is the output of a pipeline in which tasks can be stale, trajectories can omit decisive visual evidence, evaluators can reject valid alternatives, and aggregate reports can hide the cause of failure. We organize these problems into a reliability framework spanning task construction, trajectory observation, scoring, and reporting. We then audit 150 public failure-scored trajectories from five web, enterprise-workflow, and desktop-control benchmarks, find that 15.3\% of FAIL verdicts are wrong: 10.7\% are evaluator false negatives and 4.7\% are broken tasks. For genuine failures, a three-tier diagnostic taxonomy shows that verification/feedback and planning failures dominate execution/grounding errors, while a single scalar success rate can not explain. We connect these findings to newer long-horizon CUA benchmarks and derive stage-specific design rules for CUA evaluation.

</details>


### [407] [HyperClaim: Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Hypergraph Reasoning for Video Misinformation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28375)
*Xiangbo Wang,Jiasheng Zhang,Xingtong Yu,Luoqiang Lei,Delvin Ce Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了HyperClaim，一个基于判别式时序超图的视频虚假信息检测框架，通过对查询令牌、证据文本和采样帧构建异构超图，实现三类数据细粒度多模态与时序结构的保留和建模，在FactGuard时序协议下于三个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频虚假信息检测方法（全局多模态融合或自由形式多模态推理）均难以捕捉由查询短语、上下文文本和短视频帧之间耦合交互产生的局部真实性线索。这类交互具有高阶性，成对图结构无法充分建模多路跨模态依赖关系，而超图可以自然表征这些关系。

Method: HyperClaim首先以标题或基准提供的配对文本作为查询，在查询令牌、证据令牌和采样帧上构建稀疏异构超图；接着通过置信度感知过滤和源预算形成紧凑的文本-帧及短时域证据单元；随后进行自适应软入射推理并辅以残差文本-视频校准；最后通过差异感知读出层聚合文本、视觉和超边状态，输出样本级真实性分类结果。整个过程不依赖生成的推理链或外部工具调用。

Result: 在FactGuard时序协议下，HyperClaim在FakeSV、FakeTT和FakeVV上分别达到83.7%、82.0%和87.3%的准确率，超越强判别式与推理式基线；学习到的入射权重和注意力权重进一步揭示了令牌级和帧级结构。

Conclusion: 超图表示能够有效捕获视频虚假信息检测中跨多模态的高阶交互依赖性，HypherClaim在保持细粒度结构的同时取得优异性能，为无需生成推理链的样板级真实性分类提供了新的建模范式。

Abstract: Video misinformation detection is often approached through global multimodal fusion or free-form multimodal reasoning. Both paradigms can under-represent localized authenticity cues that arise from coupled interactions among query phrases, contextual text, and short temporal spans of frames. Because such interactions are inherently higher-order, pairwise graph formulations are insufficient to capture multi-way cross-modal dependencies, whereas hypergraphs offer a suitable representation for these relations. We propose HyperClaim, a discriminative temporal hypergraph framework for sample-level authenticity classification. Using the title or benchmark-provided paired text as a claim-like query, HyperClaim constructs a sparse heterogeneous hypergraph over query tokens, evidence tokens, and sampled frames; applies confidence-aware filtering and source budgeting to form compact text-frame and short-range temporal evidence units; performs adaptive soft-incidence reasoning with residual text-video calibration; and aggregates textual, visual, and hyperedge states through a discrepancy-aware readout. Without relying on generated rationales or external tool calls, HyperClaim preserves fine-grained cross-modal and temporal structure that global fusion tends to flatten. Under the FactGuard temporal protocol, it achieves 83.7%, 82.0%, and 87.3% accuracy on FakeSV, FakeTT, and FakeVV, respectively, outperforming strong discriminative and reasoning-centric baselines. Learned incidence and attention weights further reveal token- and frame-level structure.

</details>


### [408] [When Specifications Conflict: A Symmetry-Based Framework for Measuring LLM Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28384)
*Tairan Wang,Liang Zhou,Zikang Zhan,Pingchuan Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可控实验框架，用于研究大语言模型在冲突规范（conflicting specifications）下的偏好行为。通过构造显式冲突的对称实验设计，在550个冲突实例上系统比较了四种表示类型，发现模型遵循一致的偏好排序：形式语言≈自然化形式语言>纯自然语言>输入-输出示例，并将框架扩展至布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域等异构任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地需要整合可能不一致或冲突的多源信息，但目前缺乏可控且可归因的方法来分析模型如何解决竞争性规范之间的冲突。现有研究无法直接观察和分析模型在冲突规范下的选择行为。

Method: 提出一个受控实验框架：（1）构造具有显式冲突的规范对，使模型在竞争规范间的选择可直接观察；（2）采用对称性设计以减少混淆因素，支持跨表示类型的系统比较；（3）在可执行数学基准（550个冲突实例，11个函数族）上评估四种表示类型：纯自然语言、形式语言、自然化形式语言和输入-输出示例；（4）将框架扩展至布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域的异构规范冲突。

Result: 模型表现出一致的偏好排序而非随机行为：形式语言≈自然化形式语言>纯自然语言>输入-输出示例。示例效应依赖于模型能力和函数族。框架在多个领域（布尔代数、代码生成、临床）均验证了适用性。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种统一的方法来测量LLM如何解决竞争性信息源之间的冲突，适用于多样化的任务和规范形式，为理解模型在冲突信息下的行为提供了可归因的分析工具。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly required to integrate multiple sources of information that may be inconsistent or conflicting. However, there is still a lack of controllable and attributable methods for analyzing how models resolve conflicts between competing specifications. We propose a controlled experimental framework for studying model preferences under conflicting specifications. By constructing specifications with explicit conflicts, the framework enables model choices between competing specifications to be directly observed and analyzed. A symmetry-based design further reduces confounding factors, allowing preferences across representation types to be compared systematically.
  We evaluate the framework on an executable mathematical benchmark with 550 conflict instances spanning 11 function families, comparing four representation types: pure natural language, formal language, naturalized formal language, and input--output examples. Results show systematic preference patterns rather than random behavior, with a consistent ordering: $ \text{Formal} \approx \text{Naturalized Formal} > \text{Pure Natural Language} > \text{Input--Output Examples} $. Example effects further depend on model capability and function family.
  We extend the framework to heterogeneous specification conflicts in Boolean algebra, code generation, and the clinical domain, demonstrating its applicability across diverse tasks and specification forms. The framework provides a unified approach for measuring how LLMs resolve conflicts between competing sources of information.

</details>


### [409] [QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28405)
*Jiacheng Zhou,Jinfan Lv,Ruixuan Li,Longtai Zhang,Yan Wang,Wenqiang Zhang,Lizhe Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuantWAMs是一个针对世界动作模型（WAMs）的后训练量化框架，通过三种策略（共享基异常值校准、协同训练目标显著性、固定干预回滚审计）将量化决策与模型结构、回滚分布和任务目标对齐，在W4A4精度设定下实现接近FP16的性能，同时将峰值内存降至FP16的约29%并提供1.4-1.6倍块级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAMs需要联合预测未来观测和动作，其迭代去噪和闭环执行使得高效部署成本高昂。现有PTQ方法不适合WAMs，因为它们依赖开环目标、同质化模型假设，且校准分布无法反映实际部署场景。

Method: QuantWAMs引入三种策略：(1) 共享基异常值校准——仅跨坐标兼容模块池化激活证据；(2) 协同训练目标显著性——从联合视频-动作梯度计算经验Fisher分数，在校准稳定的层粒度上分配权重精度；(3) 固定干预回滚审计——利用可达闭环状态修订去噪步保护计划，不改变精度预算。

Result: 在Fast-WAM和LingBot-VA上评估，覆盖RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO和真实机器人（AgiBot G2）操作任务。W4A4主导设定下，模拟均值与FP16仅差0.2-0.7个百分点。真实机器人试验在三个操作任务上验证了部署可行性。目标视频和动作块峰值权重-激活内存降至FP16的约29%，提供1.4-1.6倍块级加速。

Conclusion: QuantWAMs通过将量化决策与校准上下文（模型结构、回滚分布、任务目标）对齐，有效解决了WAMs的PTQ挑战，在极小精度损失下实现显著的内存压缩和加速收益，同时证明了在真实机器人操作任务上的部署可行性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, but their iterative denoising and closed-loop execution make efficient deployment costly. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.

</details>


### [410] [When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28421)
*Zongheng Guo,Tao Chen,Tianli Li,Mingzhe Cui,Yang Jiao,Lei Xie,Yi Pan,Xiao Hu,Manuela Ferrario*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文定义了派生特征过度信任（DFOT）问题，即下游LLM将派生测量值当作直接事实使用或在有效范围外使用。以生理传感为例，在50,000对PPG-ECG记录上验证，基于ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏的基线方法在四个修复和特异性指标上提升1.82-6.69个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM管道中越来越多地将派生测量值作为直接事实使用，但这些测量值的有效性是实例依赖的，导致模型可能在其有效范围外信任派生特征，现有研究缺乏对这一系统性失败形式的统一量化框架。

Method: 提出DFOT框架，包含两个测试（D1测试PPG派生心律与离线ECG矛盾时的冲突接受，D2测试在误导性严重病史下对离线确认可靠PPG心律的拒绝）和五个估计量（COTR、CIR、CRR、ESRM、UHR），在50,000对PPG-ECG记录上采用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为基线与PPG-only推理对比。

Result: 在187名患者协议锁定的测试集上，基线在四项修复和特异性端点改进1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间排除零；UHR增加0.67个百分点（95% CI: -0.4至+1.7）。

Conclusion: DFOT为衡量和缓解LLM中派生测量误导问题提供了统一的评估目标，不依赖于特定可靠性生成器，且代码已开源。

Abstract: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.

</details>


### [411] [A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28432)
*Chenghan Wu,Zongmin Yu,Liu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出UNICON（UNified In-Context Operator Networks），一个展现"数值智能"的基础模型。它通过图结构示例作为上下文，推断系统中共享的预测关系并应用于同系统的查询，跨学科（包括训练中未见过的学科）无需重新训练即可接近专家水平，与语言模型智能体结合后甚至能超越专业领域专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型展现了从文本上下文中获取和运用知识的智能，但智能不应局限于语言。科学和社会系统需要模型能够从数值上下文中获取和应用知识，因此需要一种能够处理数值上下文的"数值智能"基础模型。

Method: 提出UNICON模型，利用系统内的图结构示例作为上下文（in-context learning），推断这些示例共享的预测算子关系，并将其应用到同一系统的查询上。方法基于算子学习（operator learning）与上下文学习（in-context learning）的统一框架，并可与语言模型智能体协同工作。

Result: UNICON在科学和社会系统（包括训练时未见过的学科）中无需重新训练即可接近专家性能；与语言模型智能体结合后可在训练中未见的学科超越最先进的专家模型；训练语料的多样性提升了向未见学科的泛化能力。

Conclusion: UNICON作为数值智能的基础模型，为更广泛的人工智能生态系统提供了构建模块，确立了数值智能作为独立于语言智能的研究方向。

Abstract: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [412] [LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28459)
*Pablo Manrique,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个在Lean定理证明器中构建的约束编程验证框架，同时覆盖公式级验证（如等价性、可满足性保持、对称性破坏正确性）和求解器级验证（通过翻译到MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB等外部格式检查求解器证书），实现端到端的可验证约束求解流程。实验表明，每个问题族仅需一次参数化证明即可复用于所有实例规模，将求解器搜索工作量降低达2×10^7倍，且完全在Lean内的认证最多只需几分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束编程广泛用于调度、规划、配置和验证等复杂组合问题的求解，但信任其求解结果需要在两个层面提供保证：求解前的重构（reformulation）必须是语义保持的，以及求解器必须产生正确的结果。现有的验证方案通常只覆盖其中一层，缺乏一个统一的框架来同时保证这两个层面的正确性。

Method: 该框架在Lean定理证明器中实现，包含两部分：一是参数化地证明公式级属性（等价性、可满足等价性、对称性破坏约束的正确性），适用于整个问题族而不仅是单个实例；二是通过翻译后端（将问题转换为MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB等外部格式）检查求解器为具体实例生成的证书。两个层面结合构成端到端工作流，即无需信任外部求解器即可确定约束问题的可满足性或不可满足性。

Result: 实验结果表明：一个针对每个问题族的参数化证明可被所有实例规模复用，将求解器的搜索努力降低高达2×10^7倍；整个在Lean内部的取证（certification）过程成本可承受，最大的实例也只需几分钟即可完成。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在单一框架内同时解决了约束编程的两个验证层面，实现了不依赖外部求解器信任的端到端可验证求解，且验证后的对称性破坏策略在实际求解中带来了显著的性能提升，验证开销保持在可接受的范围内。

Abstract: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.

</details>


### [413] [A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28466)
*Jia Yu,Yan Zhu,Yili He,Zilong Wang,Xinyang Jiang,Peiyao Fu,Ruijie Yang,Tianyi Chen,Siyuan Li,Zhihua Wang,Fei Wu,Quanlin Li,Xian Yang,Pinghong Zhou,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EndoCLIP，一个结肠镜检查视觉语言基础模型，从280,476份常规结肠镜报告中渐进恢复出125,756对病变级图像-文本对进行训练。该模型在病变级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中均优于通用及生物医学视觉语言编码器，其良恶性分类的线性探针在12名内镜医师参与的盲测中接近专家水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管常规结肠镜报告中记录了丰富的专家描述（如病变外观、大小和位置），但这些报告总结的是整个检查过程而非逐帧标注，导致临床发现与对应图像之间缺乏紧密关联，视觉语言模型在结肠镜领域未被充分利用。作者希望将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号。

Method: 从280,476份常规结肠镜报告中渐进恢复出125,756个病变级图像-文本对，训练EndoCLIP这一结肠镜视觉语言基础模型；通过在零样本和线性探针两种设置下进行评估。

Result: 在病变级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中，EndoCLIP均优于通用及生物医学视觉语言编码器。在良恶性分类中，其线性探针性能接近12名内镜医师在盲测中的水平。

Conclusion: 恢复发现与帧之间的对应关系可将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使得临床目标可以通过语言来描述，而无需为每个任务单独进行标注。

Abstract: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.

</details>


### [414] [Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28470)
*Antonio Delgado-Rosa,David Muñoz-Valero,Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将星载推理与生成式数据增强相结合的空中目标监视工作流，在6U CubeSat上执行低功耗边缘张量加速器推理，同时利用低秩适配微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类图像并通过伪标注增强训练数据，将全局平均精度从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811，且量化检测器可在轨运行25-30帧/秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低轨卫星空中监视面临两个相互关联的瓶颈：纳米卫星下行链路预算有限，但传统方法仍需传输TB级原始图像到地面处理；同时公开的飞机卫星数据集稀缺且存在严重的类不平衡问题。这两个限制要么延误决策时机，要么阻碍标准检测器学习稀有飞机类别的鲁棒表示。

Method: 提出一个联合解决上述两个局限性的工作流：(1) 在配备低功耗边缘张量加速器的6U CubeSat上执行星载推理，避免大规模下行传输；(2) 通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类图像，并由中间检测器自动伪标注，再与经典增强样本合并构成平衡数据集；(3) 量化检测器以适配片上内存。

Result: 平衡数据集将全局平均精度从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1分数从0.683提升至0.811；量化检测器适配片上内存后在轨投影25-30帧/秒。

Conclusion: 计算测试支持该工作流可作为纳米卫星实时自主空中监视的决策支持工具，与卫星仅作为被动数据收集器的传统弯管式架构形成鲜明对比。

Abstract: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.

</details>


### [415] [A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28481)
*Ngoc Thai Le,Thanh Ma,Umberto Straccia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化的模糊规则神经符号框架，用于自动排水管道严重程度评估。该框架将Swin Transformer神经感知模块与基于J48决策树转换的19条IF-THEN模糊推理规则解耦，通过t-norm/s-norm算子结合规则置信度进行推理。在3,244张图像（5个高度不平衡的严重程度类别）上，相比纯图像分类方法，准确率、平衡准确率、Macro F1和MCC分别提升17.9%、12.2%、23.0%和17.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动排水管道严重程度评估依赖直接图像分类，形成"黑箱"系统——视觉缺陷与最终严重程度分数之间的关联是隐式的，缺乏可解释性。研究者希望建立一个既能保持竞争力又能提供可追溯推理过程的框架。

Method: 框架分为两个解耦模块：(1) 感知模块使用Swin Transformer直接从图像预测14个多标签检测CODE等级；(2) 推理模块使用Weka的J48决策树在真值CODE和严重程度标签上训练，将决策树路径转换为19条固定的IF-THEN规则。推理通过模糊逻辑实现：CODE条件的t-norm激活乘以规则置信度，再通过对应的s-norm合并产生可解释的类别证据。评估了Product、Łukasiewicz和Hamacher三种模糊算子对。真值标签通过5个独立大语言模型对原始检查员注释进行共识分析生成。

Result: 在3,244张图像、5个高度不平衡严重程度类别的数据集上，相比纯图像分类方法，准确率提升17.9%、平衡准确率提升12.2%、Macro F1提升23.0%、MCC提升17.3%。框架在保持类别平衡性能的同时，实现了从预测CODE等级到规则支持和严重程度证据的可追溯推理。

Conclusion: 该神经符号框架有效弥合了神经感知与符号推理之间的鸿沟，在取得竞争性类别平衡性能的同时提供透明的推理链路，使排水管道严重程度评估更具可解释性和可审计性。

Abstract: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

</details>


### [416] [SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28488)
*Yunhao Liang,Xianqi Cao,Pujun Zhang,Yuan Qu,Yongzhi Qi,Ningxuan Kang,Max Z. J. Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，将供应链中原本分离的补货决策（品类选择、货源分配、补货频率、配送路线）统一为端到端的组合策略模型，通过在共享运营表示中上下文化各决策token并评估系统级效用，实现跨部门决策的协同优化，在叮咚买菜和京东的真实运营数据上优于各分离优化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代供应链中的补货规划涉及品类、货源、补货频率和配送路线等多个决策，这些决策在运营上高度耦合（品类改变需求、货源改变配送请求、路线决定系统价值），但现实中往往由不同部门用独立系统分别优化，导致缺货、库存积压和运输浪费。现有方法缺乏对跨决策阶段耦合的端到端协调。

Method: SCOPE框架将供应链实体表示为token，通过共享的运营表示进行上下文化，每个token类型映射到对应的决策接口；每个决策基于先前决策形成的部分计划逐步构建，完整计划通过共享的系统级效用进行评估。在城市生鲜零售补货场景中实例化该框架，并分别在叮咚买菜和京东的真实数据上验证。

Result: 在两个大规模供应链（叮咚买菜和京东，处于不同补货层级）的真实运营数据上，SCOPE一致地优于分别优化各决策阶段的方法以及供应链运营中常用的实践导向基线。

Conclusion: 学习和协调跨部门的运营耦合能够带来更有效的端到端供应链决策。

Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

</details>


### [417] [InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28503)
*Dorian Quelle,Lisa-Maria Neudert,Jonathan Bright,John Gallacher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个动态更新的AI基准测试（InfoOpsBench），用于评估前沿语言模型在面对国家级信息操作时的完整性。基于一个追踪俄、中、伊朗国家支持信息资产的实时监控管道（涵盖2100多个信息操作），对8家提供商的17个模型在四种提示框架下进行测试，发现绝大多数模型可被共谋用于信息操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型被广泛应用于内容生成，它们可能被国家级行为体利用来执行信息操作和虚假信息传播。现有基准测试多为静态的，容易被模型饱和（即模型在训练时可能包含测试数据）。需要一个动态、持续更新的基准来评估模型在真实信息操作场景下的抵抗能力，并揭示模型完整性方面的系统性缺陷。

Method: 作者构建了一个实时监控管道，追踪俄、中、伊朗国家支持的信息资产，从中提取超过2100个信息操作。基准网站每周更新主流说法。测试了8家提供商的17个模型，采用4种不同的提示框架，计算完整性得分（拒绝请求的百分比），并分析模型在配合信息操作时的输出特征（如捏造细节、淡化主张、事实核查率）。

Result: 大多数模型可以被共谋用于信息操作。完整性得分从8.8%到94.5%不等，跨度达85.7个百分点，且与模型规模无关。模型选择会改变信息操作的性质：有些模型捏造细节并产生比源材料更有害的输出，有些模型即使配合也会淡化主张。事实核查率在2.9%到72.9%之间波动。完整性部分与对良性主张的拒绝有关。除Z.ai的GLM 5.2外，中国开发的模型对基于事实的中国批评性主张的配合度急剧下降（相对匹配的良性主张下降48-70个百分点）。

Conclusion: 前沿语言模型在抵御国家级信息操作方面存在显著且系统性的脆弱性，模型选择对操作结果影响巨大。完整性安全与模型可用性之间存在矛盾。中国开发的模型表现出明显的政治敏感性拒绝模式，凸显了合规策略的地缘政治差异。动态基准的设计使其能够抵抗饱和，为持续追踪模型完整性提供基础设施。

Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation.
  In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%.
  Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

</details>


### [418] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出选择性的可信度受限信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update）框架，将复合认知输入按来源世界转换为弱化代理后再进行可信度受限转移，统一了标准KM更新与可信度受限更新，并刻画了两类性质良好的算子子类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可信度受限信念更新方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，无法处理仅有部分复合认知输入可被实现的情形；需要一种更具表达力的框架来支持来源相关的选择性接受。

Method: 引入选择性可信度受限信念更新算子：在每个来源世界中，先将认知输入转换为弱化代理，再执行可信度受限转移；提供语义与公理化刻画；识别一致性保持算子和最大一致性保持算子两个子类，并通过证明标准化归约建立框架的普适性。

Result: 给出了选择性可信度受限更新的语义与公理化刻画；识别了两种性质良好的算子子类；证明了可信度受限更新是该框架的特例，而Katsuno-Mendelzon更新在去除可信度限制且转换函数为恒等函数时也可恢复。

Conclusion: 该框架为信念更新提供了统一且更具表达力的理论，涵盖了既有方法同时支持来源相关的选择性接受，证明了其理论价值与应用潜力。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [419] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANTA是一个多Agent网络拓扑自适应框架，允许通信结构在推理时自我演化，通过初始化任务条件化拓扑并在部署中监控协作轨迹进行有界结构更新，在五个基准上以74.0的平均分超越最强基线5.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型多Agent系统虽然通过任务分解、Agent专业化、信息交换和中间验证来解决复杂问题，但通信拓扑通常是固定设计或离线优化目标，无法在推理时根据实际协作需求动态调整，限制了系统的适应性和性能上限。

Method: MANTA框架包含两个阶段：(1)执行前，从先前的结构经验中初始化一个任务条件化的拓扑结构；(2)部署期间，监控Agent协作轨迹，当当前组织结构不足以应对任务时，施加有界的结构更新。更新可以修改Agent角色、通信链接、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保持任务接口和Agent预算不变。

Result: MANTA在五个基准（信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行和数学推理）上平均得分74.0，超越最强基线5.8个百分点，并在PlanCraft任务上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 推理时的自我改进可以扩展到协作的架构层面本身，即多Agent系统的通信拓扑结构可以在部署过程中动态演化以提升性能，这为多Agent系统的自适应协作提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [420] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对本地计算机使用智能体（CUAs）在严格硬件约束下的推理时扩展策略进行了系统性实证研究，评估了上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度的扩展效果，发现额外计算往往带来收益递减并改变失败模式，提出本地CUA需要选择性计算分配和失败感知控制机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地部署计算机使用智能体对隐私、成本效率和实际可用性日益重要，但在严格硬件约束下提升其性能仍具挑战。虽然推理时扩展能改善前沿CUA性能，但该方法对资源受限的本地模型是否有效目前缺乏理解。

Method: 在OSWorld基准上对Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B等多个本地模型进行系统性实证研究，从上下文（contextual）、时间（temporal）、结构（structural）和并行（parallel）四个维度评估推理时扩展的效果。

Result: 上下文扩展提供历史基础改善轨迹稳定性和任务准确率，但增益随token成本增加而饱和，失败模式从重复/停滞轨迹转向过早假成功；时间扩展能减少最大步数停滞但未显著提升任务成功率；结构分解在本地两阶段智能体中引入规划和格式化开销；并行扩展部分缓解这些失败但计算成本高。

Conclusion: 高效本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制，以及围绕本地模型能力与限制设计的智能体框架，而非盲目增加推理时计算。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [421] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DualG-MRAG，一种用于多模态检索增强生成的双层框架，通过解耦的宏推理图与微匹配图分别处理全局结构推理和细粒度证据匹配，利用GNN检索器实现查询驱动的消息传递，并通过动态规划解码机制提取显式推理路径，在证据召回和复杂QA准确率上均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）在处理复杂的多跳推理任务时表现不佳。现有方法主要依赖独立的实例级匹配，无法捕获跨模态和跨文档的显式关系；而图增强方法在多模态场景中面临两难困境：融合细粒度视觉特征会导致图快速膨胀和检索噪声增加，而使用粗粒度表示又会丢失关键局部证据。作者希望解决这一"粒度困境"。

Method: 提出DualG-MRAG双层解耦框架：(1) 构建Macro Graph用于全局拓扑路由（宏观推理）和Micro Graph用于精确局部验证（微观匹配），二者解耦以抑制检索噪声；(2) 将检索建模为查询驱动的GNN消息传递过程，实现跨异构证据源的动态相关性传播；(3) 引入动态规划解码机制，从GNN前向传播中直接提取显式推理路径，替代标准输入中的孤立文档块，为生成模型提供连贯的结构引导。

Result: 大量实验表明，DualG-MRAG在证据召回（evidence recall）和复杂问答准确率（complex QA accuracy）两个方面均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过将全局结构推理与细粒度证据匹配解耦，并利用动态规划解码从GNN检索器中提取显式推理路径，DualG-MRAG有效解决了多模态多跳RAG任务中图膨胀与证据丢失之间的矛盾，为多模态复杂推理提供了更优的检索与生成框架。

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>


<div id='cs.IT'></div>

# cs.IT [[Back]](#toc)

### [422] [The Capacity Region of the Broadcast Channel with Non-Signaling Assistance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27434)
*Yuhang Yao,Syed A. Jafar*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文完整刻画了K用户离散无记忆广播信道在非信号（NS）辅助下的容量区域，证明其与Sato区域一致，即所有消息子集上的和速率界限区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广播信道的容量区域在一般K用户情况下尚未完全解决，非信号辅助作为一种超越量子的关联资源，可能为理解广播信道容量提供新的视角。

Method: 利用非信号辅助的物理特性，证明NS辅助容量区域等价于Sato区域——该区域通过对所有消息子集施加和速率界限来定义，每个界限对应于该子集接收者完全合作且在最坏情况联合信道律下（与边缘信道一致）的性能。

Result: NS辅助下K用户离散无记忆广播信道的容量区域被完全刻画，等于Sato区域。

Conclusion: 非信号辅助能力使广播信道的容量区域获得完整刻画，该区域与Sato区域重合，意味着最坏情况下的接收者合作策略即可达到最优，无需更复杂的编码方案。

Abstract: The capacity region of the $K$-user discrete memoryless broadcast channel is fully characterized when non-signaling (NS) assistance is available to the transmitter and all $K$ receivers. The NS-assisted capacity region is shown to coincide with Sato's region, i.e., the region defined by sum-rate bounds over all subsets of messages, where each bound corresponds to full cooperation among that subset of receivers under a worst-case joint channel law consistent with the marginal channels.

</details>


### [423] [Green Cell-Free Massive MIMO for ISAC: Joint Cloud, Fronthaul and Radio Resource Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27778)
*Zinat Behdad,Özlem Tuğfe Demir,Ki Won Sung,Pei Xiao,Cicek Cavdar*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向绿色无小区大规模MIMO（CF-mMIMO）集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统的跨层端到端优化框架，通过联合优化发射功率、AP工作模式、用户/感知关联、RX-AP分配以及云/前传资源，实现总网络功耗最小化，相比仅优化发射功率的方案节省超过50%的功耗，相比仅优化无线电资源的方案节省约13-15%，同时保持竞争力的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CF-mMIMO与ISAC相结合是未来6G网络中的有前途架构，能够支持新型感知应用。然而，集成感知功能会在无线电、前传和云域上引入额外的功耗，而这些功耗无法通过传统的发射功率优化方法捕获。因此需要一种跨层端到端优化框架来全面考虑并降低整个网络的功耗。

Method: 1) 提出分布式感知方案：各接收接入点（RX-AP）计算本地测试统计量，并通过加权组合策略在云中心聚合。2) 在完全信息（FIS）和部分信息（PIS）场景下推导最大后验比率检验（MAPRT）检测器。3) 建立联合优化问题，最小化总网络功耗，受通信与感知约束。4) 采用基于逐次凸近似（SCA）和惩罚松弛的两阶段迭代算法求解该混合整数非凸问题。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提出的端到端框架相比基准方案显著降低了总功耗：比仅优化发射功率的方案节省超过50%的功耗，比无线电域优化方案节省约13-15%，同时保持竞争力的检测性能。

Conclusion: 该跨层端到端优化框架能够有效管理绿色CF-mMIMO ISAC系统的总功耗，通过联合优化各域资源实现显著的功耗节约，为6G时代大规模集成感知网络提供了可行的低功耗解决方案。

Abstract: Cell-free massive MIMO (CF-mMIMO) combined with integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a promising architecture for future 6G networks, enabling new sensing-based applications. However, integrating sensing functionality increases power consumption across the radio, fronthaul, and cloud domains, which is not captured by conventional transmit power optimization approaches. In this paper, we develop a cross-layer end-to-end (E2E) optimization framework for green CF-mMIMO ISAC systems with distributed multi-target detection. We propose a distributed sensing approach in which receive access points (RX-APs) compute local test statistics and forward them to the cloud for aggregation via a weighted combination strategy. We derive maximum a posteriori ratio test (MAPRT) detectors under fully informed (FIS) and partially informed (PIS) scenarios, capturing different levels of side information available at the RX-APs. We formulate a joint optimization problem that minimizes total network power consumption by jointly optimizing transmit power allocation, AP operation modes, communication user and sensing associations, RX-AP assignments, and cloud/fronthaul resources, subject to communication and sensing constraints. The resulting mixed-integer non-convex problem is solved via a two-stage iterative algorithm based on successive convex approximation and penalty-based relaxation. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed E2E framework significantly reduces total power consumption compared to benchmark schemes, achieving more than 50% savings over transmit-power-only optimization and approximately 13-15% over radio optimization, while maintaining competitive detection performance.

</details>


### [424] [Constructing linear codes from digraphs and groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28016)
*Coen del Valle,Cheryl E. Praeger*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出了Cayley码的两种推广——图码和有向图码，研究了它们的代数与组合性质，分析了原料图/有向图的扩张性质与所构造码参数之间的关系，并相比Kaufman和Lubotzky的结果提供了改进。作为应用，构造了一个无限族的优质有向图码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kaufman和Lubotzky于2012年基于Kaufman和Wigderson定义的Cayley码首次构造了第一族对称LDPC好码，但其构造自由度有限。本文旨在通过推广Cayley码构造，引入图码和有向图码，提供更大的设计自由度，同时保留Cayley码的理想属性，并改进扩张性质与码参数之间的分析结果。

Method: 提出了Cayley码的两种推广：图码（graph codes）和有向图码（digraph codes）。从代数与组合两个角度研究这两种构造的性质，分析原料（有向）图的扩张性质与所构造码的最小距离、率等参数之间的关系，并给出比Kaufman和Lubotzky更优的参数分析。

Result: 证明了图码和有向图码具有与Cayley码相同的良好性质（如对称性、好码特性等），但具有更高的设计自由度。在扩张性质与码参数的分析上获得了优于Kaufman和Lubotzky的结果。此外，构造了一个无限族的优质有向图码，并提出了若干开放问题。

Conclusion: 图码和有向图码是对Cayley码富有成效的推广，兼具良好的代数与组合性质，提供了更大的构造灵活性并改进了已有参数分析。该工作为对称LDPC好码的构造开辟了新途径，同时留下了一系列开放问题供后续研究。

Abstract: In 2012, Kaufman and Lubotzky constructed the first family of symmetric LDPC good codes. Their construction used Cayley codes, as originally defined by Kaufman and Wigderson (2016). In this paper we present two generalisations to the Cayley code construction, which we call graph codes and digraph codes. We investigate both the algebraic, and combinatorial properties of these constructions and show that they possess the same desirable attributes as Cayley codes, but with added freedom. We analyse the relationship between the expansion properties of the ingredient (di)graphs and the parameters of the constructed codes; our analysis offers an improvement to the results of Kaufman and Lubotzky. As an application, we construct an infinite family of good digraph codes, and we propose a series of open problems.

</details>


### [425] [On The Most Discriminative Boolean Functions for Correlated Sources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28162)
*Jun Chen,Shun Watanabe,Lei Yu*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究在分布压缩框架下最大化两个相关布尔源之间Kullback-Leibler散度的布尔函数对问题。针对无偏布尔函数对及非负相关区间的相同函数对，证明了level-k函数（傅里叶系数仅支撑在第k层）同时最大化KL散度和Fisher信息，部分解决了Amari-Kobayashi猜想，并在贝叶斯分布式一位假设检验框架中证明了level-k函数的最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受Amari和Kobayashi关于Fisher信息最大化的猜想启发，旨在识别使两个压缩相关源所得分布之间KL散度最大化的布尔函数对。此前Pichler等人已证明在互信息最大化问题中独裁函数(dictator functions)最优，而Amari-Kobayashi猜想奇偶函数(parity functions)在Fisher信息最大化中最优，本文试图为非无偏情况及更广泛的框架提供证明。

Method: 利用傅里叶分析工具，研究布尔函数的傅里叶系数支撑集结构。对于无偏布尔函数对及非负相关区间的相同函数对，构造证明level-k函数（即傅里叶系数仅支撑在第k层的函数）同时最大化KL散度和Fisher信息。在贝叶斯分布式一位假设检验框架中，利用信息论不等式工具证明所有函数对中level-k函数的最优性。

Result: 证明对于无偏布尔函数对以及非负相关区间的相同函数对，KL散度和Fisher信息均由level-k函数最大化。由于level-k函数包含奇偶函数，这部分解决了Amari-Kobayashi猜想。在贝叶斯分布式一位假设检验框架下，证明level-k函数在所有函数对中是最优的。同时讨论了一个函数的版本（即Courtade-Kumar猜想的散度类比）。

Conclusion: Level-k函数在最大化KL散度和Fisher信息方面具有广泛的最优性，部分解决了Amari-Kobayashi猜想。该结果在贝叶斯分布式一位假设检验中同样成立，并为一个函数版本的散度最大化问题（Courtade-Kumar猜想的类比）提供了研究基础。

Abstract: Motivated by a conjecture of Amari and Kobayashi, we study the problem of identifying pairs of Boolean functions that maximize the Kullback-Leibler divergence between two distributions obtained by separately compressing two correlated sources. When the reference distribution corresponds to independent sources, this problem reduces to the problem of maximizing mutual information, for which the optimality of dictator functions has been proved by Pichler, Piantanida, and Matz. For the problem of maximizing Fisher information, which can be viewed as a local version of the problem studied in this paper, Amari and Kobayashi conjectured that parity functions are optimal. For unbiased pairs of Boolean functions, and for identical pairs in the nonnegative correlation regime, we prove that both the divergence and the Fisher information are maximized by level-$k$ functions, namely, functions whose Fourier coefficients are supported only on level $k$. Since level-$k$ functions include parity functions, this gives a partial resolution of the conjecture of Amari and Kobayashi. Furthermore, in the framework of Bayesian distributed one-bit hypothesis testing, we prove that level-$k$ functions are optimal among all pairs of functions. Finally, we also discuss the one function version of the problem studied in this paper, which can be regarded as the divergence analogue of the Courtade and Kumar conjecture.

</details>


### [426] [Generalized Query-Oriented Image Semantic Coding Empowered by Large AI Models and Semantic-Aware Hybrid Beamforming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28276)
*Sin-Yu Huang,Vincent W. S. Wong*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向查询的广义图像语义编码（QO-ISC）框架，利用预训练大模型增强特征表示，并结合语义感知混合波束赋形（SA-HBF）算法，在大型MIMO-OFDM系统中优先传输语义重要特征。在未见物体类别上优于传统编解码器和两种最先进的语义编码方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义编码设计未考虑用户意图，语义模型的泛化能力受限于特定数据集微调，且大型MIMO-OFDM系统中如何优先传输语义重要特征尚未充分探索。

Method: 提出QO-ISC框架：发射端根据用户查询提取相关特征，接收端基于这些特征重建图像；使用预训练大型AI模型增强通用特征表示；开发SA-HBF算法在大型MIMO-OFDM系统中实现对语义重要特征的优先传输。

Result: 在数据集内未见物体类别上评估，所提出的广义QO-ISC框架相比传统编解码器和两种最先进的语义编码方案取得更好的性能。

Conclusion: 通过引入用户查询驱动的语义编码和语义感知混合波束赋形，该框架有效解决了语义通信中意图缺失和泛化能力不足的问题，并提升了大规模MIMO-OFDM场景下的语义传输性能。

Abstract: Semantic communication is an emerging paradigm that can preserve the meaning of data during transmission. However, human users are often interested in specific semantic content based on their intent, and users' intent is often not considered in current semantic coding design. Moreover, most of the existing semantic models are fine-tuned using specific datasets, which limits their generalization capability. Furthermore, how to prioritize semantically important features in large-scale multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems remains largely unexplored. To address the aforementioned challenges, in this paper, we propose a generalized query-oriented image semantic coding (QO-ISC) framework. In the proposed framework, the transmitter extracts features which are relevant to the user's query and the receiver reconstructs an image based on those features. We use a pretrained large artificial intelligence (AI) model (LAM) to enhance general feature representations. We develop a semantic-aware hybrid beamforming (SA-HBF) algorithm to prioritize semantically important features for large-scale MIMO-OFDM system. When evaluated on unseen object categories within the dataset, simulation results show that our proposed generalized QO-ISC framework achieves better performance than the traditional codec and two state-of-the-art semantic coding schemes.

</details>


### [427] [The Capacity of a Family of Sticky Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28281)
*Mladen Kovačević*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文确定了q元粘性插入信道族中一类重复信道的容量。对于满足特定系数支配条件且支撑在1+dℤ≥0上的重复律，证明了Shannon容量等于零错误容量，均为log2λ比特/符号，其中λ是方程λ^d=(q-1)(λ^{d-1}+...+λ+1)的唯一正解。这是首次精确确定非平凡重复信道的Shannon容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复信道（repeat channels）在通信理论和编码理论中具有基础性地位，但其Shannon容量的精确确定一直是一个长期未解决的难题。此前对于非平凡的重复信道，Shannon容量尚未被精确求出，因此本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 作者考虑q元粘性插入信道（sticky-insertion channels），其中重复律（repetition law）的支撑位于1+dℤ≥0上。通过引入系数逐项支配准则（coefficientwise-domination criterion），以支配常数γ≥λ^{-d}为条件刻画信道族。其中λ是特征方程λ^d=(q-1)(λ^{d-1}+...+λ+1)的唯一正解。文章还构造了满足这些条件的显式重复律，包括加权Fuss-Catalan数给出的实例。

Result: 对于满足上述条件的重复律，Shannon容量等于零错误容量，均为log2λ比特/符号。这是首次精确确定非平凡重复信道的Shannon容量。同时给出了满足条件的显式重复律构造，包括基于加权Fuss-Catalan数的例子。

Conclusion: 本文在重复信道容量问题上取得了突破性进展，建立了Shannon容量与零错误容量相等的结果，并通过构造具体实例验证了理论的可实现性，为后续重复信道容量的进一步研究开辟了新的方向。

Abstract: We determine the capacity of a family of $q$-ary sticky-insertion channels. Fix $q\geq2$ and $d\geq1$, and let $λ$ be the unique positive solution of $λ^d = (q-1) (λ^{d-1} + \cdots + λ+ 1 )$. We prove that, for every repetition law supported on $1+d\mathbb{Z}_{\geq0}$ and satisfying a coefficientwise-domination criterion with domination constant $γ\geqλ^{-d}$, the Shannon capacity equals the zero-error capacity, both being $\log_2λ$ bits per symbol. We also exhibit explicit repetition laws satisfying these conditions, one of which is given by the weighted Fuss--Catalan numbers. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first known cases of nontrivial repeat channels whose Shannon capacity has been determined exactly.

</details>


### [428] [Low-Pathwidth GRAND: Exact Likelihood-Ordered Enumeration for BPSK Transmission over Correlated Gaussian Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28363)
*Behrooz Razeghi*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出LP-GRAND算法，针对相关高斯噪声下的软输入GRAND译码问题，利用精度矩阵Q的带限结构构建低路径宽度树状图（trellis），实现按非递减能量顺序枚举噪声模式，从而保证有限块长下的最大似然（ML）译码性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在相关高斯噪声下，软输入GRAND的有限块长ML保证要求按非递增条件似然顺序查询噪声模式。然而，可加可靠性度量和独立块近似因忽略交叉坐标交互作用，无法保持该顺序，导致首次命中的码字不一定是ML码字。现有方法缺乏在相关噪声下既高效又能保证ML特性的译码方案。

Method: LP-GRAND利用BPSK调制下精度矩阵Q来建模高斯负对数似然中的候选依赖部分，将其转化为观测依赖的二次伪布尔能量函数。该函数的交互图边{i,j}与Q_{ij}≠0对应。若Q的half-bandwidth至多为ν，则能量可表示为每层最多2^ν个状态的状态图；路径分解宽度为w时，每层至多有2^{w+1}个bag分配。通过后缀动态规划和最佳优先完整路径枚举，按非递减能量顺序枚举模式。在完整枚举且不放弃的条件下，首次命中的码字即为ML码字。

Result: 在两组[20,12]码上共10,000帧实验中，LP-GRAND与穷举码字ML译码完全一致。在标称E_b/N_0=2 dB下，对六个[64,52]码，LP-GRAND的经验BLER均低于各基于块的近似方法。

Conclusion: LP-GRAND通过利用相关噪声的精度矩阵结构实现低复杂度的高效噪声模式枚举，在有限块长下恢复了软输入GRAND的ML保证，同时在实验中优于基于块的近似方法，为相关高斯噪声信道下的软输入GRAND译码提供了理论保证与实用性兼具的解决方案。

Abstract: The finite-block maximum-likelihood (ML) guarantee of soft-input GRAND requires querying noise-effect patterns in nonincreasing conditional-likelihood order. Under correlated Gaussian noise, additive reliability metrics and independent-block approximations need not preserve this order because the matched metric contains cross-coordinate interactions; the first codebook hit need not induce an ML codeword. We develop Low-Pathwidth GRAND (LP-GRAND) for binary phase-shift keying (BPSK) with precision matrix $Q$. The candidate-dependent part of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood is an observation-dependent quadratic pseudo-Boolean energy whose interaction graph has edge $\{i,j\}$ exactly when $Q_{ij}\neq0$. If $Q$ has half-bandwidth at most $ν$, this energy admits a trellis with at most $2^ν$ states per layer; a path decomposition of width $w$ yields at most $2^{w+1}$ bag assignments per layer. In real arithmetic, suffix dynamic programming and best-first complete-path enumeration enumerate patterns in nondecreasing energy. With complete enumeration and no abandonment, the first codebook hit induces an ML codeword for any nonempty binary codebook with equiprobable codewords. LP-GRAND agreed with exhaustive codeword ML in all $10{,}000$ frames for two $[20,12]$ codes. At nominal $E_b/N_0=2$ dB, its empirical BLER was lower than that of each block-based approximation for six $[64,52]$ codes.

</details>


### [429] [Forecasting Land Art Under Climate Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28489)
*Alev Cinbarci,Sean Kalaycioglu*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段预测管线，利用1970年Robert Smithson的大地艺术作品"螺旋码头"（Spiral Jetty）作为遥感观测靶标，结合42年（1984-2025）的Landsat和Sentinel-2影像数据（1,744个影像切片），先基于IPCC AR6三种SSP气候情景预测区域温度、湖面高程、盐度和累积CO2（2030和2050年），再分别用随机森林回归和基于Stable Diffusion XL的潜扩散模型预测影像复杂度特征并生成气候条件化的合成影像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究发现螺旋码头影像的复杂度特征（置换熵、均值强度、ResNet50嵌入主成分）与湖面高程、区域温度和累积CO2存在稳健关系，影像复杂度领先湖面水位约三年，且长期趋势呈非单调变化（2015年后下降）。本研究旨在基于这些已确立的关系，构建对未来水文气候条件下该大地艺术作品状态的预测框架，并探讨生成式AI在文化遗产预测中的潜力与伦理。

Method: 采用两阶段管线：Stage 1 利用IPCC AR6 SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5和SSP5-8.5温度变化预测区域温度、南北湖湾高程、盐度和累积CO2（2030/2050年）；Stage 2a用线性回归和随机森林对14个影像复杂度特征进行投影预测；Stage 2b构建气候条件约束的潜扩散框架，使用SDXL+LoRA在1,744个切片上微调，ControlNet以气候向量为条件，配合水文物理掩码进行集成影像合成。

Result: 所有六种情景-年份组合均使输入超出1984-2025训练分布范围；随机森林模型饱和在2015年后的干涸盐滩状态；基于阈值的文解译将螺旋码头在所有情景下分类为完全裸露。扩散模型的验证结果待训练完成后发布。

Conclusion: 论文讨论了生成式推测对文化遗产的伦理影响，并提出了将预测框架推广至Sun Tunnels、Double Negative、Lightning Field和Roden Crater等其他大地艺术作品的路线图。研究展示了遥感+气候建模+生成式AI结合的跨学科方法在艺术-环境交互预测中的应用前景。

Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, provides a fixed remote-sensing target whose visual complexity reflects hydroclimatic conditions. A companion study analyzed 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and month from 1984 to 2025. It found robust relationships between coarse-scale permutation entropy, mean intensity, and the third principal component of ResNet50 avg-pool embeddings, and lake elevation, regional temperature, and cumulative CO2. It also showed that image complexity leads lake stage by about three years and that the long-term trend is non-monotonic, with decline after 2015. Building on those findings, this paper develops a two-stage forecasting pipeline. Stage 1 applies IPCC AR6 SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, and SSP5-8.5 temperature changes to forecast regional temperature, north- and south-arm lake elevation, salinity, and cumulative CO2 for 2030 and 2050. Stage 2a projects 14 image-complexity features using linear and Random Forest regressions trained on the 42-year record. All six scenario-year combinations move the inputs outside the 1984-2025 training distribution. The Random Forest model therefore saturates near the post-2015 dry-playa regime, while a threshold-based hydrological interpretation classifies Spiral Jetty as fully exposed in every scenario. Stage 2b specifies a climate-conditioned latent-diffusion framework using Stable Diffusion XL fine-tuned with LoRA on the 1,744 chips, ControlNet conditioning on the climate vector, and a hydrological physics mask for ensemble image synthesis. Code is provided, and validation results will be released after diffusion training. We conclude by discussing ethical implications of generative speculation on cultural heritage and outlining a roadmap for forecasting at Sun Tunnels, Double Negative, Lightning Field, and Roden Crater.

</details>


<div id='cs.GR'></div>

# cs.GR [[Back]](#toc)

### [430] [Compact Representation of Mipmapped SVBRDFs via Shared Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27943)
*Fengdi Zhang,Haocheng Ren,Qing Luo,Yaqing Li,Jibing Lou,Hongwei Li*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出Gaussian Texture Compression (GTC)，一种基于2D高斯表示的mipmapped SVBRDF纹理堆栈压缩方法。该方法利用跨mip级别和跨材质贴图的两个冗余维度共享高斯空间足迹，通过渐进优化训练实现高压缩质量，在重建质量和内存占用上优于行业标准ASTC，同时支持随机访问和非神经解码，适用于实时渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SVBRDF纹理的高分辨率、多通道、mipmapped特性带来巨大存储负担。现有压缩方法存在根本性权衡：块级压缩（如ASTC）支持随机访问但只能利用局部块内冗余；图像编解码器率失真性能强但不支持实时纹理直接访问；神经纹理压缩压缩率高但解码时需神经网络推理，在移动平台上产生额外运行时开销。

Method: GTC的核心观察是SVBRDF纹理堆栈中存在两类主要冗余源：跨mip级别和跨材质贴图。两者共享相同的空间支撑结构，仅附加级别或贴图特定的信息。2D高斯天然适合此特性，因为它将空间足迹与所携带的值显式分离，允许足迹被共享而值随级别和贴图变化。GTC沿两个冗余维度共享高斯，并通过渐进优化流程训练。

Result: 实验表明，与行业标准GPU纹理压缩格式ASTC相比，GTC实现了更高的重建质量和更低的内存占用，同时支持随机访问和非神经解码，适合实时渲染应用。

Conclusion: GTC通过利用SVBRDF纹理堆栈中跨mip级别和跨材质贴图的共享空间结构，以2D高斯表示实现了兼顾压缩质量、随机访问效率和实时解码性能的纹理压缩方案，克服了现有方法在率失真性能、硬件友好性和解码开销之间的权衡困境。

Abstract: Spatially-varying BRDFs (SVBRDFs) are central to material representation in computer graphics, but their high-resolution, multi-channel, mipmapped textures impose a substantial storage burden. Existing compression methods face a fundamental trade-off: block-based compression provides random access and hardware-friendly decoding but exploits redundancy only within local blocks; image codecs offer strong rate-distortion performance but are not designed for direct real-time texture access; and neural texture compression achieves high compression ratios but requires neural inference during decoding, which introduces additional runtime overhead, especially on mobile platforms. We present Gaussian Texture Compression (GTC), a compact 2D Gaussian-based representation for mipmapped SVBRDF texture stacks that delivers high-quality compression with flexible rate-distortion trade-offs. Our method is based on a key observation that there are two dominant sources of redundancy in such data: across mip levels and across material maps. Both share a common underlying structure: the same spatial support is reused, with only level- or map-specific information attached. This property naturally suits 2D Gaussians, since each Gaussian explicitly separates its spatial footprint from the values it carries, allowing the footprint to be shared while the values vary per level and per map. Building on this property, GTC shares Gaussians along both redundancy dimensions and is trained via a progressive optimization pipeline. Experiments show that GTC achieves higher reconstruction quality and lower memory usage than ASTC, the industry-standard GPU texture compression format, while supporting random-access, non-neural decoding suitable for real-time rendering.

</details>


### [431] [A Query-Efficient Stochastic Volume Rendering Framework for Time-Varying Implicit Neural Volumes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28047)
*Alper Sahistan,Haichao Miao,Zhimin Li,Peer-Timo Bremer,Joshua A Levine,Valerio Pascucci*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于delta tracking的查询高效随机体渲染框架，利用四阶段流水线和异构并行（ray tracing cores + tensor cores），通过射线预算和查询剪枝策略，实现了时间变化隐式神经表示（INR）的交互式直接体渲染，在RTX 4090上达到30-40 FPS的1024x1024分辨率渲染性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间变化的隐式神经表示（INR）是动态X射线CT等模态数据的紧凑表示方式，但交互式体渲染INR非常困难，因为便宜的内存查找被昂贵的神经推理取代。传统的密集采样光线步进方法不实用，而重采样、缓存和重训练等方法会损害便捷性和精度，且对时间变化数据不实用。

Method: 提出基于delta tracking的查询高效随机体渲染框架，采用四阶段流水线利用异构并行：使用RT cores进行光线遍历，使用tensor cores进行批处理神经评估。同时提出射线预算（ray budgeting）和查询剪枝（query pruning）策略来减少INR查询次数，提高每帧性能。

Result: 系统在RTX 4090 GPU上实现1024x1024分辨率下约30-40 FPS的渲染速度，能够收敛到高保真图像，并支持连续时间域的交互式时间探索，时间步更新仅需约1-2毫秒。

Conclusion: 该渲染器能够直接从原始表示渲染多种时间变化INR，无需重采样、缓存或重训练，实现了交互式渲染和连续时间域探索，为动态科学体数据可视化和分析提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Time-varying implicit neural representations (INRs) provide a compact representation of scientific volumes and, for modalities such as dynamic X-ray computed tomography (CT), are often the only practical way to represent the data. However, interactive volume rendering of INRs is challenging, as cheap memory lookups are replaced by expensive neural inferences, hindering the performance. Therefore, conventional volume rendering methods such as ray marching with dense sampling are often impractical. While resampling, caching, and retraining can mitigate this cost, they compromise convenience and accuracy and become impractical for time-varying data. We tackle these challenges using a query-efficient stochastic volume rendering framework based on delta tracking. Our system employs a four-stage pipeline that exploits heterogeneous parallelism, using ray tracing cores for traversal and tensor cores for batched neural evaluation. Furthermore, we present strategies to reduce INR queries via ray budgeting and query pruning, thereby increasing per-frame performance. Using our renderer, many time-varying INRs can be rendered directly from their original representation. The system achieves ~30-40 FPS at 1024x1024 resolution on an RTX 4090 GPU and converges to high-fidelity images. Moreover, the system enables interactive temporal exploration of the continuous domain, with timestep updates taking approximately 1-2 ms.

</details>
